notes.title: Dnipro River, Ukraine
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/71021e33f59da9f16d6958c6f169bca3ff076b1e.png

Amidst the wide steppe and the boundless Ukrainian horizons, where the world’s most fertile black soil nurtures life, the tributaries of the Dnipro River flow like veins of vitality, weaving intricate patterns through the landscape. The sunlit fields stretch endlessly, a patchwork of earthy tones is rich with vegetation and teeming with wildlife. These waters, abundant with fish, are a gift of nature—a sacred haven that whispers the timeless stories of generations past. We invite you to cast your line among water lilies and graceful willows in the serene beauty of this cherished waterway.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/673b7e6338320f03b78537aad2fe3189b788d700.png

Dnipro River, Level 46 offers four unique locations to explore: The Delta Fishing Lodge, The Wild Beach, The Reed Cat, and The Poachers’ Side. Yet, the adventure doesn’t end there—feel free to go ashore and discover other hidden gems scattered across the area. With plenty of space to wander, you can take your time exploring the landscapes, uncovering details along the way that we’re sure will capture your attention.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1b93d775e82f40204b75e76dd3d53439958811b0.png

This lively place is teeming with motion, from yachts and barges gliding across the water to ducks swimming and horses wandering nearby,  sheep graze peacefully on the slopes, birds soar above, and insects hum in the air. Don't forget to turn on the sound to fully immerse yourself in the atmosphere.

https://i.imgur.com/EYkdWTk.gif

Let’s take a closer look at The Delta Fishing Lodge, a small cozy angler’s base located on the edge of the picturesque Dnipro delta. It offers comfortable hotel rooms to relax after a busy day of fishing. Piers jut out into the water and provide easy access to fishing spots. For guests' convenience, the base offers motorboat and kayak rentals, making it easy to explore the river and find the best fishing spots.


https://i.imgur.com/3OFaU8f.gif

Boats and Freshwater Trolling

Speaking of boats, experienced anglers were quick to spot a key detail in the first teaser of the new location: the rod holders. Many of you guessed correctly—these holders are designed for freshwater trolling - this update introduces an exciting new fishing method!
On the Dnipro River, the rental boat comes equipped with two rod holders created specifically for trolling with spinning and casting rods. This means that every angler visiting the location can experience freshwater trolling simply by renting this boat.

https://i.imgur.com/zu4bMs5.gif 

For those looking to troll across various freshwater locations in the game, the Dnipro Motor Boat is your go-to companion. This locally produced classic boasts an authentic Ukrainian design, embodying the style and craftsmanship of its heritage. Equipped with two rod holders and powered by a 75-horsepower Neptune motor, it delivers stable and efficient performance. The durable construction makes it a reliable choice for anglers who appreciate both functionality and legacy.

https://i.imgur.com/dBPJIGj.gif 

https://i.imgur.com/Y5dD8VN.gif

Dnipro River Fish Species

When exploring a new location, the variety of fish species is always a key interest for anglers. The Dnipro River map features 32 fish species, including well-known favorites such as Carp, Northern Pike, European Perch, Zander, Wels Catfish, Grass Carp, Silver Carp, and the iconic Beluga Sturgeon.
In addition to these familiar species, the map introduces 7 new ones, expanding the diversity of catches available.  Let’s take a closer look at these species and the opportunities they present.

White-Eye Bream

https://i.imgur.com/WYvUJUf.gif 

White-Eye Bream is a ray-finned fish species of the Carp family, widespread in many large rivers of Europe and Asia and in drainages of the Black, Caspian, and White seas. These fish prefer to inhabit large, fast-flowing rivers and estuaries.

White-Eye Breams have silvery-gray elongated bodies flat on the sides and dark gray fins. These fish usually grow to a mass of 1-2.2 lb, with the maximum weight of a unique specimen rarely exceeding 3.3 lb. It is a ray-finned fish species of the Carp family, widespread in many large rivers of Europe and Asia and in drainages of the Black, Caspian, and White seas. These fish prefer to inhabit large, fast-flowing rivers and estuaries.

White-Eye Bream feeds on small crustaceans, mollusks, insects, and insect larvae.

Common Nase

https://i.imgur.com/QjZiuty.gif

Common Nase is a European freshwater fish of the Carp family. Its natural habitat is the drainages of the Black, Baltic, and North Sea, but this migratory fish has also been introduced to other parts of Europe. Common Nase prefer deep, fast-moving waters, where they usually stay in shoals.

Common Nase has a blue-gray or silvery elongated body with an orange tail. Generally, these fish grow to 9-15 inches in length and weigh from 0.6-2.2 lb. However, unique specimens are known to reach up to 3.5 lb in weight.

These bottom-dwelling fish mainly feed on algae and other aquatic plants.

Sterlet

https://i.imgur.com/Hhs78zf.gif

Sterlet is a relatively small species of Sturgeon found in large rivers in Eurasia, particularly the ones flowing into the Black and Azov seas. This valuable commercial fish prefers to inhabit clean rivers with strong currents and cool water, where it likes to hide in deeper areas with sandy bottoms.

The Sterlet has a long, narrow nose with barbels and an elongated triangular-shaped body that is yellowish-gray and covered with bony plates instead of scales. Distinguished from other Sturgeons by their small size, the Sterlet usually weighs between 2 and 13 lb, with unique specimens sometimes weighing up to about 19 lb.

European Weatherfish

https://i.imgur.com/kpNmjxq.gif 

European Weatherfish is a species of Loach widespread in Europe and Asia. It gets its name for coming to the surface and acting excitedly whenever the air pressure changes before a thunderstorm. These fish inhabit still waters of muddy rivers and are resilient to low-oxygen environments.

These small fish are yellowish in coloration, with brown bands stretching along their entire body. 

European Weatherfish usually grow to a length of about 12 in and a maximum weight of 0.5 lb.


Chinese Sleeper

https://i.imgur.com/ooueE3c.gif 

Chinese Sleeper is a species of freshwater fish widely introduced throughout Northern Eurasia and many European countries. The only known member of its genus, Chinese Sleeper, prefers to inhabit still waterways with plentiful aquatic vegetation and can easily survive even in polluted environments.

Chinese Sleepers resemble Gobies by their shape and overall appearance. These fish have somewhat chubby short bodies with varying coloration that ranges from greyish-green to brown tones with a grey belly and is covered with small spots. During mating season, however, they turn black. The maximum weight of a Chinese sleeper is 1 lb, with most specimens weighing around 0.2-0.7 lb and ranging in body length from 6 to 10 in.

These fish are carnivorous and feed predominantly on invertebrates, larvae, and other small fish, including those of their kind.

Black Sea Roach

https://i.imgur.com/TMjU7U3.gif 

The Black Sea Roach is a predatory freshwater fish. It prefers areas of rivers with a fast current, eddies, with clean spring water rich in oxygen. It usually occurs in small groups, sometimes on its own. The silvery gray body of this fish has blue reflections along its sides. They feed on insects, small fish and fry.

The Black Sea Roach is considered a rare and valuable fish.

Azov Shad

https://i.imgur.com/qEmbPgp.gif

Azov shad is a freshwater fish of the herring family that adapts to various conditions, including brackish water and sudden temperature changes. From early May, when the water warms up to 59°F, until early June, Azov shad spawns in the Dnipro, seeking the rapid current. Historically, Azov shad has been of significant economic importance for the Kherson region and an essential source of income. People of Kherson simply love this fish!

Monsters

Yes, you read that right—Monsters, plural! Because two monsters are better than one, aren’t they? Fans of the legendary Sturgeon Leviathan Monster will be thrilled to know it’s staying in the game. Even if you’ve already completed this mission before, you’ll have another chance to catch it.

But the monster tale doesn’t stop there—a brand-new beast is making its debut: the formidable Thorn-Ripper.

This aggressive creature prowls the depths of the Dnipro River, a true survivor hardened by centuries of evolution. Its spikes, razor-sharp and menacing, developed as both a defense mechanism and a weapon to dominate its territory. According to legend, the Thorn-Ripper harbors a grudge against fishermen, its rage fueled by the loss of its family to human nets. Stories tell of this monster ramming boats with its needle-like spikes, leaving behind nothing but shattered hulls and terrified anglers.

Catching the Thorn-Ripper won’t be easy. Cautious and elusive, it can only be lured by something truly extraordinary—like the Wasp Walker, a one-of-a-kind bait designed to tempt even the wariest predator.
We won’t spoil the surprise by showing you what this monster looks like. You’ll just have to discover it for yourself when the battle begins. Good luck, Brave Anglers!

https://i.imgur.com/VuEyQq1.gif 

Lures, Baits and flavors of Ukraine

In addition to the baits, lures, and groundbaits already available in the game, new options are on the horizon for anglers to discover. Let’s take a closer look at what’s in store.

Salo and Salo Generalske

Salo, the traditional cured pork fat, is a beloved staple of Ukrainian cuisine. If you know what prosciutto is for Italians and jamon for Spaniards, then you understand what salo means for Ukrainians. Typically salted and sometimes infused with garlic or spices, it can be enjoyed raw, smoked, or cooked. But salo isn’t just a culinary treasure—it’s also an excellent bait for carp fishing. Its dense, fatty texture holds securely on the hook, releasing a tantalizing aroma that Common and Grass Carps find irresistible. This bait shines in warm weather, as the heat helps the fat release its enticing scent.

Salo Generalske, on the other hand, is a more refined, premium version. Enhanced through marinating, smoking, or unique seasonings, this "fancier" salo offers an even richer flavor profile. And just as it would impress diners, it’s sure to drive fish wild with its delectable allure.

And as a small taste of Ukrainian hospitality, take a moment to explore the location—you might stumble upon some free pieces of salo to use as bait.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0bafbe941f8b627c8ea9ed8c5bab5afd84383090.png

Mole Crickets

While not as appetizing to people as salo, the mole cricket is a true delicacy for fish. This insect, with its hard exoskeleton and juicy body, is a natural treat straight from the Ukrainian landscape. Its earthy, organic aroma works wonders in attracting predatory fish. Widely regarded as one of the best baits for Catfish and other large species, the mole cricket is a trusted choice for local Ukrainian anglers, blending tradition with the wisdom of nature.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ea9b30ef5d445129e2ea9cfeb9d34d9e3b17eb7c.png

Crawling Worms

Thanks to its high flexibility and considerable size, the crawling worm makes an ideal bait for catching large fish. It is effectively used together with different types of hooks, which significantly raises the chances of a successful catch. This bait performs especially well in muddy and overgrown waters, where Catfish dwell and feed. Yummy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/dfefc8da995b4cd9085730269898a3c58597ac98.png

Cicada Spoons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/95a4436c5f12df1f9d99057ca73210522e95cabb.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1b5cc9eb6e8ad2a0d01e7a5cec76d5f6d8fc4067.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d1dd83ea4ceafb94d8106f970e97065188d35408.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b4b9dc44bdb7d35391e12517e90440cf7ebb8d46.png

The Cicada is an effective lure designed for fishing at different water depths. Its compact body with front lead weight ensures an accurate and far cast, even in strong winds. The Cicada works great for catching a variety of predatory fish including Bass, Pike, Zander, and Trout thanks to its ability to adapt its vibration to the situation.

Twerky Runners

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8a8cd01657e34fc7dc0a374ddeede27f940eca98.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/234fac7eabae0cdb74df532b877bb753effa1b71.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2718adb1afc8435519a8aebc6ad77a68066a01e7.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5c227f1539e824b604ad0071e86e43e8b37c5085.png

The Twerky Runners are new effective crankbaits that have a special hunchbacked shape to ensure a fast, high-frequency wobble. The lure has a special aroma that attracts catfish. Rigged with razor-sharp highest quality hooks, the Twerky Runner is great for trolling and particularly suited for using with more powerful fishing rods. Choose your Twerky Runner from a selection of sizes and colors depending on the fishing conditions and how deep you want to go.

Freaky Walkers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9ac5d2b31ffd2c710d935249e8a7b6626211e614.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7176d1bcc7e0207fd5d8238fac787be33ad9bb6f.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/08e6c71b4975943f8360b9b7522d05dc374f197e.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d980cb553bd43161ea387b76427b9eee6c811c9d.png

Walkers are surface lures that imitate the movement of a wounded fish, frog, or insect on the water surface. Thanks to their ability to produce a variety of movements, Walkers effectively provoke Perch, Chub, Asp, and other surface predators into attacking.

Bionic Slugs

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7c62bdab4d040490426f5d8ce89676db7d828cdc.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/531a0909546adf3b8f63217e14e2b92448e950ef.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0127d14238580f0e456c595ef32fc7fe44a941e5.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/de8ba71db1bd7f89ca87f32d482a9cdfbc2cdc07.png

Bionic Slugs are innovative lures that imitate a fast-moving fish and are made of high-quality silicone. With its realistic shiny scales and a forked tail, this lure mimics a wounded fish to attract predators. Its soft tail moves attractively in the water. The slug is easy to use: just put the hook through its mouth and tighten the line through the metal ring. Suitable for catching various types of fish in both fresh and salt water.

Thorn Jig Heads

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/130429cbe05cf584581c7b10159c447366059afa.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/29fe95bb720ee2b408785793fc60b2e8898ec639.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/234d384e48e8c140738c5349640c28b355b32e42.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/49b832b939cb8c9a13a2234cc1566c5caa4ade62.png

Developed by the world’s top anglers, the Thorn Jig Head proves that the devil is in the details. Small changes lead to significant improvements. The beveled weight provides a louder and clearer impact even on soft ground, while a special plastic spike holds the silicone in place, allowing you to make the retrieve in difficult conditions. The weights are painted in colors visible to fish even at great depths, significantly increasing your chances for a successful catch!

Groundbaits

We’re also  introducing a variety of new groundbaits, particles, and aromas, but we’d like to highlight a few personal favorites that hold a special place in our hearts. These selections carry a nostalgic charm for our team, reminding us of cherished memories from childhood.

Gingerbread Classic Groundbait has a characteristic sweet aroma and is made with spices, which means it can effectively attract fish even in cold weather. Low cost and high efficiency make this groundbait unique.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/84e4e2b5a957bc7ec49eade3de3968185729af54.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/91cf34d0bb87d537b596d63c2b5f05e860d60bcb.png

Mamalyha, a traditional Ukrainian-style corn porridge similar to Italian polenta, brings a rich, hearty flavor to the table—and to the water. When transformed into feeder bait with added aromas, it becomes an irresistible treat for all kinds of peaceful fish, including Bream and Carp. This time-honored recipe blends tradition with effectiveness, making it a go-to choice for anglers seeking success.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7abfce3e36dc65e1d4bd1cc660228194133ca628.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f348e1eba3105c788f24693d59e4cdc3dac53cae.png

Corn sticks are not only a delicious snack popular in Ukraine, but also a feeder groundbait ideal to use for peaceful fish! It has an attractive texture and smell that ensures fish are active near your fishing spot for a long time.

Baked milk is a classic Ukrainian drink made by slowly baking milk overnight in a cooling traditional stove. This gentle process caramelizes the natural sugars in the milk, giving it a rich, caramel-like aroma. A geyser groundbait infused with baked milk aroma is designed to quickly release its enticing scent into the water, creating a powerful "geyser" effect that draws fish from afar. Especially effective in deep fishing, this chum's sweet fragrance guarantees to capture the attention of nearby fish, ensuring a successful catch.

https://i.imgur.com/s9JoS1Y.gif

This location is deeply cherished by the Fishing Planet team, and we've poured all our passion into creating it. The Dnipro River has inspired countless generations, serving as a symbol of Ukraine’s natural beauty and cultural legacy.  The esteemed poet Taras Shevchenko captured the river’s essence in his powerful words:

"The mighty Dnipro roars and bellows,
The wind in anger howls and raves,
Down to the ground it bends the willows,
And mountain-high lifts up the waves."

These vivid lines not only highlight the river's grandeur but also convey its wild, untamed energy, which contrasts beautifully with the calm and peaceful experience that awaits you. As you explore this iconic waterway, you’ll follow the path of generations who’ve found inspiration, sustenance, and a deep connection to nature along its banks. Welcome to our home and enjoy your stay!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/10b319b233e2e34296edfb1caf930822e3dd391d.png

notes.title: Akhtuba River: Important Update for Anglers
notes.content:
Dear Anglers,

We would like to inform the community that in approximately three weeks, the Akhtuba River location will be removed from the game. To ensure a smooth transition, we have prepared a comprehensive compensation plan for all players affected by this change:

Relocation and Refunds

 All players present at the Akhtuba River location at the time of its removal will be transferred to the Global Map.
 Any travel expenses, unused paid stay costs, and boat rental fees for this location will be refunded in full.

Keepnet Fish

 If you have fish in your keepnets at the time of removal, they will be automatically sold, and the credits will be added to your account.

License Refunds

 Players with active licenses for the Akhtuba River location will be compensated for any unused days.
 For players with unlimited licenses, the full cost of the license will be refunded.

Marker Buoy Reimbursement

 Any Marker Buoys used at this location will be returned to you and made available for use at other locations

Achievement and Mission Completion

 Achievements in progress at the Akhtuba River location will be marked as completed.
 Players in the middle of completing the exploration mission for this location will also have the mission marked as completed.


All compensations will be processed automatically, and your in-game balance will be updated to reflect the adjustments outlined above. If you have any questions, feel free to contact support@fishingplanet.com, we will be happy to help.

We appreciate your understanding and cooperation as we work to make this transition as seamless as possible. Our team remains committed to delivering the best possible experience for all anglers.

Tight lines and don’t forget the Thanksgiving Event is live now, so don’t miss out!

notes.title: Thanksgiving Day 2024: Golden Turkey Rush
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/04d5f472393aa8f62fb05b288bf589620cf11edf.png

Dear Fishing Planet Community,

Thanksgiving is just around the corner, and we’re inviting you to celebrate with us by preparing a festive feast that captures the spirit of gathering, gratitude, and tradition. This special meal reflects the togetherness and sense of community that Thanksgiving represents.

Join us for the Thanksgiving Day event and embark on a thrilling series of missions designed to help you craft delicious dishes for our holiday feast! Those who show the most determination will be rewarded with the exclusive Indian Canoe, along with in-game currency and unique fishing items. Our special Thanksgiving Cauldrons will be simmering delightful fish dishes for our festive dinner. Catch fish of all sizes using delicious Golden Corn. From Lone Star to San Joaquin, whether it’s Sunfish or Trout, no underwater dweller can resist its allure. 

Harvest Golden Corn at event locations to enhance your chances of landing that perfect catch. Earn the exclusive Pilgrim Hat reward by completing the Catcher in the Corn achievement. 

Featuring mid-level waterways as the primary event locations, this celebration is designed for players of all skill levels to enjoy and complete. Thanksgiving Day embodies the spirit of harvest, unity, and, of course, Fishing Planet! 

Mark your calendars—the event will run from November 21st, 10:00 AM UTC to December 2nd, 10:00 AM UTC.

The search for the Cornucopia

Our journey begins at Lone Star Lake, where your first task is to discover the Horn of Plenty, or Cornucopia. Once you find it, you'll unlock a series of missions that will guide you in preparing all the delicious holiday dinner dishes and setting up the perfect Thanksgiving feast at Lone Star Lake.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4e9a4b736cc7a7bc21b43d298eb437331f881f7b.png

Thanksgiving Dinner

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/92275192173df131f693edde6168c5eb89445835.png

To start cooking every dish, you’ll first need to find the magical Cauldron at each event location. Once you do, you will receive tasks that will guide you in gathering all the ingredients necessary to create a variety of delicious fish-inspired dishes.

Start your journey at Lone Star with the delectable Assorted Fish Platter, then venture to Lesnivila for the savory Stuffed Carp. Don’t miss out on the delightful Fish Pie waiting for you at Mudwater!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/51b4dd48346f7c7276bef37a59d7bfad3ed2accf.png

As you explore, treat your taste buds to the rich flavors of Trout Sashimi at Rocky Lake, prepare the perfectly Grilled Carp at Neherrin, and warm up with a bowl of Festive Fish Soup at Ghent Terneuzen.
Continue your gastronomic exploration by uncovering the tempting Smoked Trophies at Tiber, indulging in Gefilte Fish at Quanchkin, savoring the flavorful Trout Tacos at Saint Croix, and experiencing the exotic Chinese-style Carp at San Joaquin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9b4ae476690aa0933c56df97d8bd0efcae577010.png

Table decorations

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f0a4f2bf6618654731a9561ded3378bb8f22915d.png

Every festive dinner table deserves the perfect decorations, and you can find them at Emerald! Once you've completed cooking  any of the holiday dishes, be sure to stop by Emerald to collect decorations that will complete your holiday table.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2c6c659f2489a21794c5890ef812a1e8a2bc12a6.png

Corn Harvest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/017280433402a85d71b60f34c5af89a234e9ef68.png

And don’t forget to explore the Corn Fields—where you can find thriving corn stalks ready for harvest! Gather some delicious Golden Corn to use as bait for your fishing adventures. You can also discover corn stalks beyond the event locations, including the Selenge River, the Amazonian Maze, and the Congo River. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7998433cb05dd3b5aa5668769297c491c60e24e4.png

Secret Missions

There are also two secret missions waiting to be uncovered! The thrill lies in the surprise—you’ll only discover them after you accidentally complete it and receive your reward. So, keep your eyes peeled and be adventurous; try different approaches and see what surprises await you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/068c15b7ef1dfb1a082b58fadc00ac86aaeacf7a.png

Thanksgiving Cornucopia Pack

Celebrate the holiday fishing tradition with the Thanksgiving Cornucopia Pack! This is your chance to snag the exclusive Thanksgiving edition True Pilgrim’s Doublet. This comprehensive package is fully loaded, featuring three high-quality telescopiс setups and all kinds of tackles, a spacious keepnet, and an abundance of bait to ensure a bountiful Thanksgiving catch. And the special Pilgrim Jacket will elevate your look and complement the Pilgrim Hat you'll receive upon completing the Catcher in the Corn achievement.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2654610/Fishing_Planet_Thanksgiving_Cornucopia_Pack/

As we prepare for this Thanksgiving event, we want to take a moment to express our heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you in the Fishing Planet community. Your passion and support make our journey together truly special. Thank you for being such an important part of our community, and we look forward to celebrating this season of gratitude with you. Happy fishing and happy Thanksgiving!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0ebf812ad2d0b199c202a0ffa5a5a9308c744399.png
____________________________________________________________________
Be sure to check out our social media channels—there will be some treats waiting for you, just like always!

notes.title: Welcome to Topwater Kayak Cup!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ca1cfa3b0201468cb229f2de8491e0f79840da39.png


Hey there lovely Anglers,
Welcome to the Topwater Kayak Cup tournament! Get ready to take on the challenge of catching a range of fish with topwater lures under special rules. Show off your skills by landing big fish and reaching the Finish Point before time runs out!

Travel to top fishing spots around the world, from Lake Falcon in Oregon and the Selenge River in Mongolia to California’s San Joaquin Delta. Reach the semifinals at Michigan's Saint-Croix Lake, and compete in the final showdown at Lake Maku-Maku in Peru!

The Topwater Kayak Cup 2024 will be held from November 12th until November 17th, with the Registration starting on November 11th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier.

The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:

 11th of November - Registration for the Tournament begins.
 12th of November - Qualifier 1 in Oregon, FALCON LAKE.
 13th of November - Qualifier 2 in Mongolia, SELENGE RIVER.
 14th of November - Qualifier 3 in California, SAN JOAQUIN DELTA
 16th of November - Semifinal Round in Michigan, SAINT-CROIX LAKE.
 17th of November - the Grand Finale in Peru, MAKU-MAKU LAKE.


Important:
Be sure to check out all the Tournament details in the Tournament Tab within the game. A key aspect of this tournament is that only Spinning and Casting rods with top water lures are permitted. You cannot use rod stands and stringers, only keepnets are allowed. Please, note that boats are prohibited, players must use only kayaks during the tournament.

Also, don’t forget to review the Competitive activities rules before registering. Remember, only one Fishing Planet account is allowed per device for tournaments. If you're playing with family, each member will need their own device to participate.

Enjoy your chance to get a whole bundle of goods including all the terminal tackle, equipment and licenses you need!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1804846/Fishing_Planet_Topwater_Kayak_Pack/ 

Fight for the championship title and a prize pool packed with Credits, BaitCoins, and unique fishing gear. Good luck and have fun!

notes.title: Release Note Patch 9
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a219ce21e0c03a7e4dba3b0f8245f49c61e6c3fd.png

Hey Anglers,
We’re here to bring you the latest update with improvements, fixes, and enhancements to make your Fishing Planet experience smoother and more enjoyable. This patch addresses key gameplay issues such as crashes, freezes, and loading problems, while also delivering various UI enhancements, animation and sound tweaks, and updates to Fishing Together sessions. We've also fine-tuned features like Photo Mode and made several other important improvements based on your feedback.
In addition, we’re thrilled to announce the release of our brand-new Halloween event, which will start within a few days! Stay tuned for a detailed announcement with all the missions and challenges coming your way. Dive into the patch details below to see what's been fixed and improved in this update.

[olist]
Gameplay Improvements 

 Resolved the running screen issue after catching a fish.
 Fixed an issue where the incorrect line was equipped when applying a template.
 Resolved the issue of characters freezing in the third-person view.
 Fixed the game freezing issue when casting the Mokonzi bottom rod and putting it in the boat rod holder.
 Fixed the time freezing issue in the Grouperzilla mission.
 Fixed the issue where the rod stand failed to disappear after the player boarded a boat multiple times in a single session.
 Fixed line distortion and stretching on telescopic rods when reeling in a fish.
 Resolved line overstretching on float setups.
 Fixed freezing after viewing tournament results in the Hall of Fame.
 Fixed game freezing when fast-forwarding time; the mouse cursor would not disappear, blocking subsequent actions.
 Fixed the bug where Head Starter Sinker remained in the setup when adding lures.

notes.title: Release Note - 5.0.7
notes.content:

Hey Anglers,

A new bug fix patch has been released. This update addresses a wide range of issues and brings improvements based on your valuable feedback.

One of the key issues we’ve addressed in this patch is the bug where the 'Keep/Release' buttons were missing after catching a fish. In our testing, we were unable to reproduce this bug after the fix. However, since such issues can depend on various factors specific to different devices, we kindly ask that if you encounter this problem again, please don’t hesitate to report it to us at support@fishingplanet.com.

Here’s an overview of the improvements and bug fixes included in this patch:

Visual and Sound Enhancements:

1. Fixed an issue with grass textures not displaying on Maron River.
2. Addressed the issue where character footsteps on the wooden pier were inaudible.
3. Fixed silicone lures hanging parallel to the ground after catching a fish on the gaff.
4. Resolved an issue where the game’s start screen music would override in-game music settings.
5. Adjusted the excessively bright map on the tablet.
6. Fixed an issue with the boat engine sound persisting after a saltwater competition.

UI and Navigation:

7. Updated the "Buy Receive" and "Product Details" windows in the UI.
8. Fixed the scroll bar disappearing on the license purchase tab.
9. Addressed an issue with the map zoom functionality in Volans and Scutum.
10. Resolved issues with the scrolling function in the Fish Storage description.
11. Reworked pop-ups for item selling and repairing.
12. Improved map interaction on tablets by adding an input lock for better navigation.

Gameplay Improvements:

13. Resolved an exploit that allowed players to instantly reel in fish by maneuvering the boat in small circles while trolling.

16. Resolved the issue where players could slide on boats from water onto land.
17. Addressed a bug where the player could not exit the bait selection if Game Chat was opened via keyboard and RB/LB was pressed on a gamepad.
18. Fixed issues with fish schools moving too fast on Blue Crab Island.
19. Corrected the varying depths of lures during trolling when held or on a stand.
20. Resolved a bug where the camera movement was restricted when retrieving fish from the water.

Tournament and Competition Fixes:

21. Resolved broken flag displays in some tournament locations, also fixed the issue where flags appeared to be floating in some areas.
22. Addressed an issue with the player not receiving their score in qualifiers after disconnection.
23. Fixed an issue where fish caught from the boat after being disconnected did not count towards tournament scoring.
24. Resolved issues with the boat’s position resetting in boat competitions after a disconnect.
25. Corrected an issue with the Apply button

Fishing Together (FT):

26. Resolved input blocking issues when using stands with PS controllers in FT sessions.
27. Fixed an issue where the boat was moved to the center of the map after the host disconnected in FT sessions.
28. Corrected a bug where FT guests could receive the "Extend Stay" window before the host.
29. Fixed synchronization issues in FT sessions when spawning on a boat.
30. Resolved issues with the FT Finish screen when moving from FT room into a random room.
31. Fixed several issues related to the Fishing Together sessions, including syncing player positions and controlling the yacht after disconnects.

Photo Mode and Visual Glitches:

32. Fixed the camera clipping through Motor Boats and Bass Boats textures in Photo Mode.
33. Resolved character positioning issues when using Photo Mode on the bass boat.
34. Addressed the issue where the character was displayed under the pier after being ashore from the fishing yacht at Green Harbor.
35. Corrected the fishing line color discrepancy between Photo Mode and first-person view.
36. Corrected an issue where rods could be cast into the walls in the marina at Kaiji No Ri.
37. Fixed a bug where fish would detach from the gaff when the player rotated their character side to side.
38. Fixed incorrect fishing rod animations during compost pile interactions.

Inventory and Item Management:

39. Corrected template issues where incorrect fishing lines were equipped.
40. Addressed the problem of setup slots shifting to empty slots after a game restart.

Various Improvements and Bug Fixes:

41. Resolved an issue with the "Reel of Fortune."
42. Corrected issues with rod shaking in the character’s right hand while putting on glasses.
43. Addressed a bug where the Fish Finder's depth did not match the scale depth on older devices.
44. Resolved problems with mouse cursor visibility after joining private UGC competitions.
45. Added translation for Trolling XP Multiplier in all languages in the game.

We deeply appreciate your ongoing support and patience as we work to enhance your gaming experience. Your feedback and bug reports have been instrumental in helping us identify and address issues. Thank you for being a part of our community and for your continued understanding as we strive to make the game better for everyone.

notes.title: Happy Fishing Planet Anniversary!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c5ed9d52c2d4180ff332e8c19545b57746ae64ee.png

Dear Anglers,

Fishing Planet’s Anniversary falls on Sunday this year, so we are announcing a whole weekend of celebrations!

Nine years ago, we launched the game on Steam. Since then, we've expanded to PlayStation, Xbox, Apple, and Android. Over the past year, we've launched on the Epic Games Store, and we’re not stopping there—stay tuned for news about another platform release coming soon!

Our community has grown significantly, now boasting nearly 29 million players across all platforms. We've become closer to you with the launch of our official Facebook group, which has been growing rapidly. In just eight months, we've reached 15,000 members, coinciding with hitting 15,000 members in our official Discord server. It’s a great pleasure for us to see our community expand and look forward to more exciting moments together!

In the past year, we've introduced Clubs and Club Leagues, new fishing mechanics, and our biggest update yet: the Ocean. Saltwater fishing, Fishing Together with friends on the same boat, new fishing yachts, navigation buoys, trolling, a 3D start screen, and even kitty cats added into the game! Behind the scenes, we've also made significant strides, releasing hotfix patches for all platforms simultaneously twice, which means 16 patches in one day!

This nine-year journey feels like a full circle for us. When we first created Fishing Planet, we dreamed of offering both freshwater and saltwater fishing experiences in breathtaking locations around the globe. With 25 maps worldwide and now ocean fishing in the game, we've turned that dream into reality. Seeing our vision come to life is incredibly rewarding, and we couldn't have done it without the support and passion of our amazing community!

The end of one circle means the beginning of a new one. We are already working on new saltwater and freshwater locations, new events, and many other features that you will soon discover in our DevDiaries.

And of course, we have prepared something special for the celebration!

First, we are excited to launch the Sailor Collection Pack. It includes a sleek and stylish ocean outfit with the coolest purple glasses, a powerful spinning setup, and saltwater casting gear as fierce as a beast! You'll also get tons of terminal tackle, along with a high-tech six-slot rod case. Enjoy seven days of access to Kaiji No Ri with Premium and the advanced license. Whether you're looking to extend your saltwater fishing adventure or explore the ocean for the first time, this pack is a fantastic deal!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3892ef40eec50e09ea01800e9ccfbbbf132f05f4.jpg

Another highly anticipated event for our players is the Fishing Planet Anniversary License and Travel/Stay Discount. From today until August 14th, enjoy up to 60% off all unlimited licenses and travel and stay costs at all locations! Plus, there are discounts on 12 and 6-month Premium available on Steam and Epic Games platforms. This is the perfect time of year to make some long-term investments—enjoy!

Plus, if you haven’t yet, come join our community on Discord and our official Facebook Group. Stay tuned for updates and participate in the Fishing Planet Anniversary giveaways for a chance to earn exclusive rewards. We have prepared several activities for this weekend, which will be announced soon. We love treating our community not just during big celebrations like this one, but also on random weekends throughout the year, so stay with us!

Thank you for being a vital part of this incredible journey and inspiring us to continually grow and improve. Your enthusiasm and support mean the world to us. We’re excited to celebrate with you this weekend and to keep crafting unforgettable fishing experiences together.

Tight lines and happy fishing!



 Discord
 Facebook Group

notes.title: Release Note, Patch 5.0.5
notes.content:
Dear players,

We have prepared a huge bug fix patch for you today. 
We’ve taken your feedback into account regarding XP and credits for fish in Kaiji No Ri and have made some adjustments. The prices for fish have increased, and you'll now earn more XP when trolling with saltwater gear. XP in Fishing Together sessions has also been boosted - the more players on the boat, the more XP each of you will receive. Additionally, don’t forget that you get an XP bonus when fishing with your club mates, so fishing with them on the same boat is always a win-win.

We’ve also modified the fish fights, making it easier to reel in big catches faster, and as a result allowing you to gain more XP in less time.

After receiving feedback about the Fishing Together Mastering Missions being too difficult, we've made some adjustments to make them more achievable. The amounts of fish needed to catch in all three missions have been reduced. The name of the mission "Fishing Together Hunt: Plugs" was changed to "Fishing Together Hunt: Trolling", and plugs are no longer required lures for completing the mission, now you can use any trolling lures of your choice.

Here’s a detailed list of what’s been fixed and improved:

1. Fixed the character appearing in the water after reconnecting the Fishing Together session host in the game. Yes, the drowning guy has been finally rescued! 😁
2.Fixed the issue of disappearing reel sounds in Japan.

94. If you've read this far, let us know in the comments! We love knowing that our detailed (and sometimes long-winded) patch notes are read at least by someone till the end.

We hope these fixes and improvements make your gameplay more enjoyable. We're continuing to work on other issues and will address them in upcoming patches. notes.title: Welcome to The 4th of July Event: Independence Treasure Hunt 2024!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/391e6b17d19210724a5daa91b607a09013c4552c.png

Hey Anglers!
American Independence Day is coming, it’s time to go on a treasure hunt! This year we also have a surprise for our Canadian anglers. It is Canada Day on July 1st, and you will have some treats from us to celebrate it with Fishing Planet!

The event kicked off today, on June 27th at 10:00 UTC and will be live until July 8th 10:00 UTC and will be held on all the American locations from Lone Star Lake, Texas to Kaniq Creek , Alaska.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/59bf082027ea8b60ed3f38dac5ca17fd5e04ee8d.png

Join the Independence Day celebration missions and contribute to the restoration of the George Washington Monument! Embark on an exciting adventure to find fragments of Washington's battle saber, lost over a century ago. notes.title: [Steam/EGS] Patch Note 5.0.3
notes.content:
Hey Anglers,

Here is another hotfix patch for Steam and Epic Games. First of all, we want to let you know that the problem causing incorrect rank displays for some players has been fixed. However, rank corrections are being processed individually, so it may take some time before the changes reflect on your account. If your rank hasn't been updated yet, please be patient—it will be corrected for all players soon. Thank you for your understanding and patience!

Here’s the list of other bug fixes and improvements:


 Added a notification when PondPass expires.
 Added information about broken items in the "Stay ended" window.
 Fixed issue where the "Stay ended" window did not appear after time was fast-forwarded.
 Fixed sound effects (splash sounds) and missing music in the starter scene after reconnecting.
 Fixed the issue where only clubs from the player's region were displayed when filtering by "All" countries.
 Resolved issue where the player's purchased premium account was disappearing.
 Fixed issue where previous messages in the chat were not displayed if the player left and re-entered the room.
 Minor bug fixes for the 4th of July event.
 Corrected mistakes in translations in different languages.
 Fixed issue where shadows from objects in the Kaiji No Ri marina were not displayed.
 Resolved issue with incorrect flow where the "Stay ended" window did not appear after time was fast-forwarded during an Fishing Together session.


We appreciate your reports and patience while we work on resolving the issues. Tight lines and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Patch Note 5.0.2
notes.content:
Dear Anglers,

We have just released another patch addressing bug fixes and improvements reported over the past few days. While there are still a few issues we're actively working on, rest assured these will be resolved in the next hotfix patch. We appreciate your patience and continued support as we work diligently to enhance your gaming experience.

In addition, we'd like to address an important matter: we've conducted another ban wave based on our anti-cheating reports. Currently, these bans are temporary, but this is for the last time, and they will become permanent if those players attempt to use cheating software again. We want to stress that using any third-party software to alter gameplay in Fishing Planet is strictly forbidden and will result in a permanent ban.

Responding to some concerns about us joining the list of games that use Denuvo anti-cheat, we want to assure you that Denuvo operates with minimal impact on performance, ensuring a smooth gaming experience, and prioritizes user privacy, collecting only necessary data to prevent cheating. This improvement was primarily made to fulfill our community's request, and we firmly believe it will ensure a safe and fair gaming environment for all.

Lastly, we’ve been receiving many questions about the release of the Ocean Update for consoles and mobile platforms. We know you’re eagerly awaiting this update and appreciate your enthusiasm. The ocean update has turned out so huge that we needed to take some more time to optimize it better for smooth performance on all the devices. We will announce the release date within a few days, so stay tuned and thank you for your patience.

Here is the list of resolved issues:


 Fixed the twitching animation issue on the 3D retrieve indicator.
 Addressed the system lag accompanied by a characteristic sound.
 Fixed the issue where pressing the "A" button did not open the first mission group list after switching mission group tabs.
 Adjusted the speed at which fish drag boats and kayaks. Now, the speed better correlates with the fish's weight and strength and the weight of the boat.We've made it slightly faster based on players' feedback while keeping the mechanic realistic.
 Bottom/Feeder Setup: Correctly displays the sinker when viewing the setup in templates.
 Fixed the issue where the rented yacht would sink after the player came ashore on the Kaiji No Ri island.
 Fixed game logic initialization for placing rods on stands in the settings.
 The yacht no longer tips over after being returned to its start position.
 Improved server performance for the Ocean Update
 Fixed the issue where the background in photo mode did not change for the guest after teleporting to a navigation buoy in Fishing Together sessions.
 Addressed the occasional weather desynchronization between the host and guest after time rewinds in Fishing Together sessions.
 The boat rental window no longer appears twice if the session time ends while the host is offline.
 Fixed the issue where players would spawn directly in the boat during the Fishing Planet Boat Series Tournament.
 Club List now correctly displays clubs from all regions when filtering by country with "All" selected.
 Resolved the intermittent inability to navigate with a gamepad in Kaiji Ni Ri location.
 Fixed the issue where the guest saw the host's cast rod detach from the boat and move away after joining a Fishing Together session.
 Bait is now correctly consumed on the Livebait Trolling Rig.
 The "Tight Lines!" achievement is now properly credited on Steam.

Tight lines and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Patch Note 5.0.1
notes.content:
Dear Anglers,

Yesterday marked a historic day for Fishing Planet with the release of the Ocean Update, and we're thrilled to see your excitement! We've received tons of feedback from you, and while many of you are loving the new ocean features, we know there are a few things you didn't like as much. Your feedback is incredibly important to us, so we wanted to address some of the most talked-about issues before we share the list of bug fixes and improvements.

We've heard your concerns about the Denuvo Anti-Cheat software. We want to assure you that Denuvo is designed to prioritize user privacy, collecting only the necessary data to prevent cheating. In the first 24 hours, we identified and dealt with many cheating players, helping to ensure a fair and enjoyable experience for everyone.

Some of you have mentioned that reels wear out quickly when using max drag. We understand this makes the gameplay more challenging, but max drag wasn't intended to be used the way it has been. This change is meant to make the game feel more realistic. To keep your reels in good shape, try to avoid using max drag continuously.

Last but not least, regarding the time-forward cooldown during nighttime: we initially enabled it because many fish species are active at night. However, after hearing your feedback, we’ve decided to revert this change. There will no longer be a nighttime cooldown, so you can enjoy uninterrupted gameplay.

Here is the list of other bug fixes and improvements:


 Corrected boat antenna rotation in Fish Radar.
 Fixed a bug where the guest would experience a freeze and black screen when the host finishes a Fishing Together session.
 Corrected the message displayed upon event mission completion.
 Applied minor fixes to the XP Modifiers window.
 Implemented minor fixes for Ocean Missions.
 Resolved an issue where players would be placed in a different room after returning to a Fishing Together session.
 Fixed texture issues on the Scutum Boat.
 Addressed an overlap of multiple tags on the same spot on the Tablet in Fishing Together sessions.
 Applied various physics fixes.
 Relocated navigation buttons for switching tablet modes.
 Fixed UI bugs in different tablet modes.
 Resolved an issue where the boat wouldn't move if the player at the helm was changed while in reverse.
 Corrected the message about the end of the map displayed on the local map.
 Fixed animation issues for big reels where the hand texture was seen through the sleeve while reeling.
 Prevented the Extended Fishing Together session window from appearing in the guest's window after accessing the local map.
 Fixed performance degradation during long play sessions.
 Fixed a minor bug with Club invites.
 Implemented anti-cheat improvements.
 Resolved a photo mode bug for the Monster Fish Striped Marlin and other minor issues in photo mode
 Fixed an issue where the yacht would tip over and fly up high after being anchored.
 Corrected the pale appearance of boat and kayak slots compared to other slots.
 Fixed the issue where saltwater sinkers were not working in carp setups.
 Resolved the problem where it was impossible to buy items from the Lures and Baits category tabs in the Global Shop.
 Applied various fixes to the Shop interface.
 Fixed the preview for empty templates.
 Optimized server workload for better performance.


Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback. We hope you enjoy the improvements!
The Fishing Planet Team

notes.title: Release Note 5.0.0: Ocean Update
notes.content:
​{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/016e1857e5eb32e7d67798031e4c3674fc461fbb.png

Hey Anglers,

The most expected release note in the Fishing Planet’s history has arrived. Let’s go!
Here is what’s new:


 Kaiji No Ri, Japan New map with an enormous 400 sq km (almost 100,000 acres) of ocean, home to 18 dynamically moving fish species, including Bluefin Tuna, Striped Marlin, Mahi Mahi, plus Bigfin Reef Squid, among others. Accessible to players at level 83, with a new maximum level cap raised to 90, this expansive location offers a wealth of new challenges and opportunities. As customary in Fishing Planet, players of lower levels can unlock access to the map by purchasing a DLC pack with a pond pass for 30 and even 60 days. This time, we're offering two DLC packs, providing you with greater flexibility and convenience in choosing their preferred option!

 Ocean water simulation As a standout feature that deserves extra attention, incredibly lifelike ocean water simulation, complete with various types of waves, including intense storms. The ocean's appearance will dynamically change based on weather conditions and wind patterns, offering a truly captivating experience. Immerse yourself further with realistic sounds of birds, wind, and water splashes, enhancing the authenticity of your ocean adventure.

 Sea Life Simulation System Featuring dynamic zones that highlight schools of predatory fish near the water's surface, birds actively hunting for bait fish, and pods of dolphins and majestic blue whales gracefully navigating the ocean depths. Immerse yourself further with additional elements such as cruise liners, regattas, and trawler boats, creating a vibrant and lifelike maritime environment that dynamically changes depending on the time of the day and weather.

 Fishing Together Now, you can enjoy fishing with 2, 3, or 4 players on the same boat, depending on your chosen vessel. Invite your fellow anglers for a fishing party, and even let them take the wheel if you fancy. Plus, you'll earn an additional XP bonus for Fishing Together! The more anglers you have onboard, the higher the bonus for each of you. And if you're all clubmates, you'll also receive the club room XP bonus. Fishing Together also implies that the players share common fishing conditions: common bite rate, weather, and time for all participants. Rest assured it doesn’t mean that your fellow anglers can catch all of the fish and leave not Dive into an exclusive series of group missions and achievements, tailored specifically for Fishing Together, a first in Fishing Planet!

 Brand new fishing yachts for ocean fishing All the new boats are compatible for Fishing Together sessions. Rent a boat for two players using in-game credits, or opt for the Scutum™ and Volans™ Fishing Yachts accommodating 3 and 4 players respectively, available in DLC packs. All boats feature two rod holders for each player, allowing one more additional rod in hands. There’s no longer a need for a keepnet when fishing on a boat, as all boats are now equipped with ample built-in fish storage. Equipped with state-of-the-art FishFinders 360™, these vessels detect fish across surface, mid, and bottom water layers. Navigate with precision using the new Detailed Navigation Map, Echo Sounder, Compass, and Speedometer panel.

 In addition to the boat control panel equipment Players get new Tablet software that will have not only usual tools such as already familiar to players marker buoys, but also new Navigation buoys, and additional Tabs with Echo Sounder and Fish Finder 360™, which will become available after players complete special Maintenance Adventures missions.  

 Navigation buoys New special buoys, available on the new location, used to mark your favorite fishing spots and teleport among them for fast and easy exploration of such a vast location.
 
 Over 500 new saltwater items Over 500 new saltwater items are now available in local and global shops! These additions include delicious fresh baits like spiny lobsters, flying squid, gutted fish, and innovative saltwater lures such as pilkers, plugs, squid jigs, bucktails, trolling octopuses, and teasers like squid chains. Equip yourself with the latest super powerful saltwater gear, designed to reel in massive ocean fish weighing over 270 kg (almost 600 lb)! There is a new addition to the Global shop: the Saltwater Tackle section, featuring all the saltwater items. For your convenience, these items are included in all the shop's dropdown menus. Special high-performance saltwater equipment was added to the Premium Shop as well.

 As mentioned above, two Ocean DLC packs are now available for purchase Players can choose between two fishing yachts that hold 3 or 4 players for Fishing Together. Both packs include powerful gear, multiple baits and lures, additional storage slots, and tackle wagons for up to 300 tackles. 

 The Japan Odyssey Pack offers a larger four-seater boat, a 60-day pond pass with an advanced license, and more marker and navigation buoys.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2922540/Fishing_Planet_Japan_Odyssey_Pack/

 The Ocean Voyager Pack provides a smaller boat for three players, a 30-day pond pass with an advanced license, and marker and navigation buoys. Both packs allow players to bring friends and have all the necessary items for saltwater fishing. Choose the one that best suits your needs.   

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2922530/Fishing_Planet_Ocean_Voyager_Pack/


 Saltwater trolling  Fishing technique used in the ocean where one or more fishing lines, baited with lures or baitfish, are drawn through the water behind a moving boat. This method targets various saltwater species, including larger pelagic fish like tuna, marlin, etc. which are known to chase moving prey. Saltwater trolling is a dynamic and exciting way to fish, offering anglers the opportunity to cover large areas of water and target a variety of species in different oceanic conditions.

 Free spool mechanics Which will enhance your fishing experience, especially for bottom fishing at great depths. This feature is available on all reels in the game, whether for saltwater or freshwater fishing. It allows for precise control of your line, enabling free immersion of lures or sinkers to significant depths with an open spool and securing the line at the desired depth with a closed spool. This added functionality offers greater accuracy, especially when the bottom topography is unknown and considering the fact that the depth of the ocean will be more than 100 meters at many spots, making it easier to target specific depths and fish species.

 Completely revamped the Pull-and-Reel mechanics system Provide a more immersive and realistic fishing experience, mirroring the dynamics of ocean fishing. Expect fish fights to be more challenging but also more rewarding, as they replicate the true struggle of reeling in massive ocean catches. 

 Gaff
Gaff animation for the retrieval and retention of large ocean fish.

 New Competitive Activities and Rewards 4 new Kaiji No Ri competitions, 11 achievements, 20 new exclusive saltwater X-series items
 
 Dozens of new missions Including exclusive Fishing Together missions that can be accomplished only with other anglers on the same boats, and Maintenance Adventures to improve the equipment you use on your Tablet as s reward.

 New anti-cheating solution We are dedicated to providing a fair and enjoyable gaming experience for everyone. To combat cheating and ensure a level playing field, we integrated the Denuvo Anti-Cheat system for Steam and Epic Games Store players. This decision highlights our commitment to maintaining the integrity of our game and protecting our community from unfair practices. You can find out more about it here.
 
 A small but nice new addition: meet the very first NPC in the game!  The marina administrator, who works tirelessly from early morning until late night, ensures the port runs smoothly and loves cats. He might need your assistance with calibrating new navigation tools. When you spot him, don't hesitate to approach and ask if he requires any help. You will also have a chance to deliver some treats to the kitty-cats on the pier.

 Reel of Fortune After many player requests, The Reel of Fortune is finally available on Steam.

 Time forwarding cooldown has been added during nighttime  The day cooldown was originally implemented when night fishing wasn't part of the game, the night cooldown became necessary later on. Considering the numerous fish species in the ocean actively biting during both day and night, adding the night cooldown was essential with this update. An important thing to note is that there won’t be any cooldown for forwarding time to the next morning when selling fish.
UPD: After hearing players' feedback, we’ve decided to revert this change. There will no longer be a nighttime cooldown, so you can enjoy uninterrupted gameplay.

 Changes in deterministic user-generated competitions  As requested by players, there will be less randomness. The weather and bite rates now match real conditions on the waterways, meaning dedicated training will give you a better chance to win, making the process more fair and rewarding.

 New start screen While the game loads, you'll now see a stunning 3D ocean scene featuring boats, birds, dolphins, and a whale breaching the water.
 
 New settings options  Players can now adjust the volume of boat sounds and regulate water quality with more precision.

 Numerous bug fixes and enhancements Have been implemented, including updates to the reel damage system and drag behavior to eliminate exploits related to the "unbreakable setup”. We’ve also implemented a new wear system for tackles: freshwater items will wear out faster in ocean water, just as they do in real life. As the bugfix list is very long, we suggest reading it in a different article HERE.


We're thrilled to announce the completion of this monumental update and extend our gratitude to all of you for your patience during its development. We eagerly await your feedback and wish you an incredible experience out on the ocean!

notes.title: DevDiary: Introducing Ocean Tackles
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2daacb871d8d69f41d4279f3fd781c4047710169.png

Hey there our beloved Anglers,

The launch of the new Kaiji No Ri ocean location in Japan, which is just around the corner, will  bring with it over 500 new inventory items specifically designed for this unique fishing environment. Fishing in the open sea introduces a host of new challenges, including new fish species, unpredictable weather conditions, and a completely different water consistency.

The fish in the ocean are notably larger, requiring significantly more powerful setups to fight and reel them in. With depths reaching up to 500 meters in some places, anglers need heavier sinkers for bottom fishing. New tackle materials provide enhanced resistance to saltwater corrosion for durability in the ocean. Additionally, fishing from a boat, rather than the shore, requires equipment that can handle the movement while trolling and the formidable fight of larger ocean fish.

Today's DevDiary introduces the exciting new items for ocean fishing, including delicious fresh baits like spiny lobsters, flying squid, gutted fish, and giant chunks of fresh fish. You'll also find innovative saltwater lures such as pilkers, plugs, squid jigs, bucktails, trolling octopuses, and teasers like squid chains. We’ll showcase saltwater rods and reels, and reveal some details about the new animations in the game.

Let’s dive in!

Saltwater Tackle in the Global Shop

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/808d6a8a57066512b2f9d8fabc5a8027b841582b.png

The first thing you'll notice when you open the Global Store is a new section dedicated to Saltwater tackle. Upon opening it, you'll discover a whopping 31 pages featuring a wide array of tackles for ocean fishing, ranging from level 81 to level 90. 

Additionally, in all the tabs' dropdowns, you'll find new sections for saltwater items in their respective categories.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/670c3233c03ca1dcf8088fa9473cbfc4e468cbc3.png

Now, let’s take a closer look at the saltwater core gear available in the shop. The selection includes spinning, casting, and bottom equipment specifically designed for ocean fishing. We'll highlight a few examples to give you a sense of what to expect and what to look forward to.

There are four Saltwater Spinning Rods all in the Kōdo Kyatchā Series by the renowned Japanese company Tsurihito™. As one of the oldest and largest manufacturers of extra heavy rods, Tsurihito™ has created the exclusive Kōdo Kyatchā with SamuraiDo® technology. These rods feature eight reinforcement layers of high modulus polyethylene "gel fiber," carbon fabric, and polymer resin, offering exceptional strength and remarkable flexibility. Despite their power, the rods have light and strong blanks, equipped with guides featuring silicon carbide inserts to prevent line tangles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5380dba63ff5edde34aacbae7ed33d9a9128abcf.png

Bottom rods are represented in AquaStrike FJ and Ryōshi Kaito HJ series.

AquaStrike FJ by Fletch and Bradford™ are short bottom rods at attractive prices. They are perfect for fishing in conditions where it is impossible to swing far enough when casting and throwing the bait far. Made with alternating layers of fiberglass, these sleek looking rods are strong enough to take on big fish. The rods are equipped with strong and reliable guides that resist unexpected and heavy loads to withstand the significant weight of the fish.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bf0948aa26548a66a74b279a38910dcb634a3095.png

The Ryōshi Kaito HJ are powerful short rods from Tsurihito™. The innovative technologies used in their production make these rods unique for bottom sea fishing. The nanofibers used to reinforce the rods with NanoFlexyPoint® technology create an incredibly strong and flexible construction. The rods are equipped with a complete set of reinforced roller guides and roller tips that can withstand heavy loads under extreme fishing conditions. All poles are treated with a special anti-corrosion protective layer against the aggressive marine environment, which increases the performance of the rods.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3943893805103e5f26dd118a008a8d81489ffad4.png

The shop will feature a diverse range of Saltwater Casting Rods, spanning six different series from Tsurihito™ and Fletch and Bradford™. We'll showcase two of these series as examples.

The Kōdo Tatsu Umi Pro casting rods from the latest Kōdo series by Tsurihito™ will captivate casting saltwater fishing enthusiasts with their unique properties. The rods deliver exceptional balance and power while still looking sleek. The innovative technology of applying each of the eight composite reinforcing layers to the rod provides it with the highest strength and flexibility. The unique placement of the guides allows you to use not only fishing lines, but also thin braided cords without problems and overlaps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9386f702e11830b9c186229ca5b50d04202353ef.png

The ReefRider Max trolling rods from Fletch and Bradford™ are a masterpiece of engineering and design. Developed to perform in the toughest conditions, these rods are equipped with a complete set of roller guides and saltwater resistant roller tips. Innovations were used in the manufacturing process, including the Ultra Resonance System® technology, as the use of composite high-modulus materials made it possible to obtain unique properties of the rods: the ability to instantly return to their original position after peak loads, plasticity, and high sensitivity!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a24c61aa22948c7a33eecbdbaf7d4806e6682800.png

The saltwater reels are simply stunning. Here are a few examples for you, but there will be much more!

The Tsunami Koiru Series are powerful spinning reels by Tsurihito™. They have a fairly large size but are easy to operate and don't require special care. Being one of the most reliable reels in their class, they fully meet all the main requirements of a modern angler. A special boron nitride coating on the various 3D-BN® reel mechanisms guarantees exceptional strength, durability, and wear resistance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7cc6410071b1c5240d0e9b8eacedc1055c694e42.gif

The TsuruOceanSeries from Tsurihito™ are saltwater baitcasting reels that you can trust 100%. These reels easily and smoothly overcome the resistance of heavy loads, which allows you to cast both weightless plastic lures and heavy ones with accuracy, and also increases the casting distance with less effort. The spool, rotor and parts of the drag mechanisms of the reel, made using the innovative TatsumakiLite® technology from an ultra-light and strong alloy, are wear-resistant and provide high-speed winding. They have a waterproof body that is resistant to the aggressive marine environment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/58922f78e13c8a73ee40d63f808c9bfea9560466.gif

The FlowCatch saltwater baiting reels series by Fletch and Bradford™ were manufactured specifically for anglers for whom reliability is the main requirement in saltwater fishing.They possesses huge free-floating spool capacity, AntiRust® protected instantaneous anti-reverse brake bearing, StopWet® waterproof gasket, and other benefits of FaBula® protection technology. The lightness and strength of the body combined with the power and smoothness in reeling in the largest marine dwellers puts them ahead of any other reels of this class!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3b3769d8bdbb124ed26d17f76aec5771f296553f.gif

The powerful RaidenWheel Heavy Duty reels from Tsurihito™ are designed for deep sea trolling or bottom fishing at depths of more than 100 meters. Constructed from an ultra-light, wear-resistant TatsumakiLite® alloy, the spool, rotor and drag parts provide ideal high-speed winding. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f0766bfdfd5694a98984ab8fb4127952ef1e7be0.gif

There will also be dozens of new saltwater lines, leaders, hooks, and sinkers. Each item is specifically designed to meet the demands of ocean environments and resist the corrosive effects of saltwater. You'll have everything you need for ocean fishing, including trolling.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1c8851b5f658f1e27dc6638e0200ef14f746fb85.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/649cdf439ea8a280acdc691495a73eb41ea9e0b6.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/05b9d0b6fe7c79ac4984af1b103330cf29ec23ab.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7037bd206ce15e76fe227475a383d8b8a71cac15.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/91e44629a26e28bd4d8d3f44fa3f1fe81b4b0876.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c6587f982cc038e138868f30a3ecd103a9081057.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/740e23a6e235fbfe264af43e37cdb8e45698c728.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c9f26ae1d3e39d6358f03193131f56ab490a16b4.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fdb07a4826b76635637af08957f26ec0cf337fda.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5feb3a5319bb45a6b6a5b003b7247abe091201a9.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5d02ba8d30fbb8db3a4bb7701d4e4030958b9147.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2ca922ca7f1cfbc646f4b95524705e1cc15c6d3c.png

You'll have everything you need for ocean fishing, including trolling.

As for the lures, you will have a lot of new things to choose from.

You'll find regular lures in the shop, as well as trophy items available as mission rewards. Additionally, you can earn exclusive X-Series and Club-Series items.

Plugs -classic wooden trolling lures. Their elongated body is weighted with a metal tip and fitted with a powerful hook on the other side.They are ideal for trolling Tuna, Marlin, Mahi-Mahi or Wahoo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c7f97a70b0d93c0bdfc3caef30215180f9bc0f09.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5ea32a9dea916e8efa941c53a41c816a84889186.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/aa772a9fd0c2d660d15bac212ce0728ec780f930.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a8aa3e3a616ac1653f14e40239febdee4ce9eb1f.png

Pilkers - oblong jigs with the front-placed center of gravity. They are equipped with one, two, or three hooks on leaders (mainly located in the head of the lure) and are intended for casting and vertical jigging. Amberjacks, Trevallies, and Dogtooth Tunas respond best to this lure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b5e83ac985d00816a145acc83c6c0566c6e35af9.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1151d5137964a90a56ca319638bb0968d55f18bb.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4ce885b0b984bf4f72e874921d7db2ccdae9b737.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/64946675e67e6e6a3fde914456fb3f7803ff9df0.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/32f14e95a6279be472985f78f0af76c853344277.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7bfcf2b3ac850098a0130c751db1ea2c700e37ea.png

Bucktails -  casting lures, made in the form of a small metal fish with a long, fluffy tail made of synthetic fibers. Their main purpose is casting and jigging, as well as trolling. Mahi-Mahi, Striped Bass, Snook, and other fish that live in the surface layer are happy to bite at this bait.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4d45f5b4b64e69ef76de1af5fa2d185fc4a16a08.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/395d62d298ee68177d31ff246240d22f8645d1d4.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b1acb647293ad65c912a919e5ac53beb2131530c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a735a81faf27997c9a0823e8bdd3880ada11aff7.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/677c58531376a098e54c9c5d9459af43a8940b57.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/18954ef9f735322ec6b00811af890fc200d257e6.png


Trolling Octopuses are silicone lures that resemble skirts. They are one of the most popular marine lures and perfect for beginners. They are made in the form of an octopus and have realistic tentacles. This lure is designed for trolling Tunas, Marlins, Mahi-Mahi, and Wahoo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/063e98ba03458032121452860434109b98d1e617.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c91488c2e2f22ed881aac7b655bde48adb5beeab.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/dfdafb2b1b2cc861487a557cb9e60ad4627f01a5.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3cdbe90591fc61bcdbf6d2d60221c4f004f77ae7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/af2ce6fcc897bef3cffb2d16e27d59f28d635e59.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/329b3c1b2ccfa6d54f6cf0870f8d54706ccf8250.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/efab63a51db99686612d1efc1134d8533ff8f908.png


Squid jigs  are popular front-loaded jig lures for recreational squid fishing with spinning rods. They resemble shrimp in shape and color and are made of plastic and sport two crowns of barbless spikes, which catch the squid’s tentacles when it’s attacking the lure. The absence of barbs makes it easy to remove the caught squid, but it also increases the chance of it slipping away, so while catching the squid your fishing line shouldn't go slack even for a second.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ad9c6999b88cf38c0e54fb4bf750c42cbd68ea78.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3fc45038dbc298ab6e8400ebab2fef650edc13d3.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9db39996df0d4313ef5250bad1c2a1229d1a74e7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6fd9ce6da905d4d86e39339303893afcded25fda.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2a250f714042f9a0965791d5dcc953f34632a4a1.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b3461a67eac90ad6a794afaad1ced5cfa30a3da4.png

Squid Chains are teasers imitating a flock of squids. They consist of several silicone squids, located one after the other on a monofilament 2- or 3-meter-long line. As a rule, the main lure with a hook is attached behind the last squid. They are ideal for catching Tuna, Marlin, and Mahi-Mahi.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bb78c05e19ad2c112d083c678689a5985780f273.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2eb9d289d1c682719014a54ff1c762e07edc74c4.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/083e1a4c8d7b299d3b8815f5498818faac302bf8.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/37e110351924de3bf2f51729fadee9029174be6f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6e2b450f0ad152c18490233fdf0cae804cf8b4f4.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d184af587922bc60361709e389789decd6000c9f.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/39ac6c4ce29e6d8b89de0595c85f9cb26507c75c.png

There will be plenty of fresh baits like Japanese Jack Mackerel, Japanese Flying Squid, Japanese Anchovy that are excellent for all pelagic predatory fish such as Tunas, Marlins, Mackerels, Bonitos, Yellowtails, and Trevallies. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/137b31773ea9f815ba8dc2d0214763b48a1e6fcc.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e6a4cefacae6d8f2914a7eebc51adf6325d9308d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/533c0e28da91521fd114f31a1b18b6cc2dc3bc6a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7afe5f65a175c4d153b09a026f7e29fe35616368.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bc1b120bd2f61c5d9a5b8390fbe774441a6b82a9.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d591f9fb2365189a15434b76eb1d30f813712de7.png

Japanese spiny lobsters are valuable commercial crustaceans in Japan, while also making a perfect bait for the Giant Grouper, as well as  gutted fish. Fish stripes are best for bottom fish like Snappers, Trevallies and Amberjack, but these fish won’t skip the chance to taste gutted fish as well.

As usual, the game features a local shop at the new location. It will offer the most common items you might need, ensuring you won't have to travel back to the Globe if you run out of bait or forget something. For your convenience, the local shop will have two sections.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/391ca67e798c9fb87bf9d542046af1f68c678fea.png

Another exciting addition is Free spool mechanics that will enhance your fishing experience, especially for bottom fishing at great depths. This feature allows precise control of your line, enabling the free immersion of lures or sinkers to significant depths with an open spool and securing the line at the desired depth with a closed spool. This added functionality offers greater accuracy, especially when the bottom topography is unknown and considering the fact that the depth of the ocean will be over 100 meters at many spots, making it easier to target specific depths and fish species. Additionally, a gaff has been added to the animations, used for bringing large fish aboard the boat, further enriching the overall fishing experience.

This was a brief introduction to the ocean inventory items available with The Ocean Update and some of the new animations, but there's much more to come. We've also started working on a new matchmaking system for competitions in the game. Our goal is to revise the competition rating and leaderboards to make them more dynamic, fair, and motivating for players of all skill levels and fishing experience.

While we put the finishing touches on the final details of the Ocean Update, we thank you for your patience and continuous support.

Tight lines and see you soon!
