notes.title: Welcome to Amazonian Maze in Brazil!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/06054496730c72e90dcc9b78d4507f9e76ef0dc3.png

Welcome to Brazil! 
You are in for an unforgettable tropical adventure in the maze of islands and canals of Amazonia!

You can find out more useful information about the new location in our Dev's Diaries.
New maximum level — 70

9 different locations, each with distinct atmosphere:

Stone Flower

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/05746d836e4f52e80d3a4813fee3b17fd144478a.png
If you travel further to the center of the maze of waterways and canals, you will find a rocky plateau. For thousands of years the river has been smoothing and polishing the stones, transforming the shore into a flat platform, ideal for swimming and fishing. Huge boulders protect the plateau from the wind and add to the pleasant atmosphere of seclusion. By the way, the water is deep, so enter with caution!

Rio Grande Hotel

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8860774d64f0d44192f8518460a7d1cb0d934b0d.png
It seems that this picturesque backwater area was specifically designed for watching beautiful sunrises and sunsets! The primordial beauty of this deep-water bay has certainly been instrumental in establishing a popular floating lux hotel. Take a look at the floating deck, where you can take pleasant walks, and the convenient landing pier. 

Orchid Shore

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1e1188bf6d5cee8e422a49461c744d9f4c51f602.png
If you’re looking for a perfect place for some solitude and contemplation, head straight to the wild orchid garden in the northern part of the river maze. The air here is heavy with the unique fragrance of tropical flowers. The orchids bloom right on the submerged trees peeking out of the water. This shallow bay is home to many fish species that prefer still waters.

Abandoned Temple

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2ae0f50cbbaa2ebf46b5bd7f3f7d92a7b5056aec.jpg
Ruins of a small catholic temple are visible on the edge of the island in the eastern part of the Rio Negro maze. In the olden days churches were built to last forever, and this one is no exception – decades of desolation later, its walls still hold against the encroaching jungle. Even the locals can’t remember why the church was abandoned, but one has to agree that the ruins look very atmospheric.

St. Sebastian Church

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/58b72c30445d9448c2ad80ecb33f3751e7cfe973.png
An example of modern-day Catholic architecture, St. Sebastian Church can be found in the very middle of the river maze. Most times it’s incredibly quiet and calm here. The church only becomes busy on Sundays, when boats bring local Catholic believers from all over the area for the mass. You can just about see a convenient landing pier nearby. 

Mboya Village

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7eb97c44c1e1ff7052bd24324461c91264d634a4.png
This settlement is located on the long strip of land that very much resembles a snake tail. This might be why it is called “Snake Village” in the local language. Or maybe it’s because of the abundance of reptiles around? In addition to several fishing huts with thatched roofs, the village also has a church with a tall wooden cross in front of it to mark the gathering place for local celebrations and Catholic masses. The river is rather deep here, with tall palm trees growing along the banks.

Acanga

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b5bf9d455b65c3353b287ab9472163b1ae7cf3f4.png
In the eastern part of the tributary, there is a remote islet with a wooden carved statue in the middle, that locals refer to as "Acanga". Most Brazilians are Catholics, but some people still practice shamanic cults in the midst of the rainforest. Peculiar carved stones, shrines, statuettes of gods and skulls of sacrificial animals clearly signify a place of religious worship. Entering such a place, try to be respectful and not disturb the local shamans and spirits!

Stilt Hut

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d2f6cd4c0534a5f57bf705fc1e1772e6e4432c91.png
This lonely wooden dwelling looks long abandoned. Alternatively, its owners really don’t have time for refurbishing it. Given the stilts it might be a fishing hut: the locals probably keep their tackle here, or even use it as a fishing spot, to hunt for species who inhabit shallow waters overgrown with reed.

Giant Palm Tree Beach

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4097279dd68520f4338fe3976d70fb207dd5fedd.png
After exploring infinite jungles or rocky banks, how refreshing to see a beach with beautiful white sand! One can notice giant palm trees on the other side of the beach, which gave this place its name. Cozy summerhouses with palm leaf roofing are visible not far away from the shore. If you look at the water long enough, you might see a river dolphin or a small river cruiser. Local anglers say deep waters and peculiar riverbed have made this part of the river a favourite spot for large catfish.


6 new unique Amazonian fish species

Take in a lungful of the thick humid air of the jungle and be ready for a fast-paced fishing adventure, because the fish is phenomenally feisty and large: 
the hefty Orinoco Bass, 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8f164177525e7729e9d2a31da9aeab4e6b57f56b.png
Orinoco Peacock Bass (Cichla Orinocensis) is a large species of Peacock Bass native to the Rio Negro and Orinoco River basins in South America that usually prefers to inhabit slow-moving blackwater rivers.
These fish are easily distinguished by their tropical coloration: golden shimmering bodies with large dark spots on the sides and a blueish dorsal fin. Orinoco Peacock Bass can reach up to about 2 ft. in length with a maximum recorded weight of around 11 lb.

the aggressive Bicuda, 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/545de76441b343b4aa9806ccddf0c4a75c2bc6b1.png
Bicuda (Boulengerella Cuvieri) is a South-American freshwater fish native to the Amazon region, inhabiting its many tributaries as well as other rivers throughout the countries of the continent. These fish tend to stay close to the surface in areas with rapids and strong currents, hiding behind debris, logs, and rocks.
Bicudas have long, gray pike-like bodies with elongated reddish tails and sharp, comb-like teeth. Fully grown specimen usually reach a maximum weight of 13 lb, and up to about 2.9 ft. in length.

the massive Piraiba catfish weighing up to 330lb,
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9a9f8bd88695d5280408335e21cf1a7333768f85.png
Piraiba (Brachyplatystoma Filamentosum) is the largest Catfish species found in South America. It inhabits the Amazon and Orinoco basins, where it thrives in both freshwater and brackish habitats.
Piraiba have elongated bulky silvery gray bodies with white bellies, which makes them look a little bit like sharks. They are easily distinguished by long barbels and red markings on the lips. But Piraiba’s key trait is their truly enormous size, with a maximum recorded length of 11.8 ft and a record weight of over 441 lb.

the incredible Electric Eel, 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ec9aea3deda97df20e5957c2f92d59627aa738a4.png
As you can figure from its name, this eel can generate a strong electrical charge. This helps it to not only attack its future prey but also successfully navigate its way in muddy waters. Thanks to an organ called the Weberian apparatus electric eels also have excellent hearing: you will have to try hard if you want to sneak up to this fish. 
Banded Aracu
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/eb44689fe524c97993397f4e5ddda495b3ee845e.png
is a fish species most often found in South American waters (the Amazon and Orinoco basins). These small and swift schooling fish prefer to inhabit fast-flowing rivers. During the wet season they also thrive in flooded forest areas.


the Bull Shark, which adapted to the freshwater environment and whose weight can reach up to 440lb! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f4e23940606e91805df8982700d2fee93dae2aec.png
These sharks prefer to hunt in muddy waters on their own, sneaking up to the prey and dashing suddenly before the attack. There have been attacks on humans, so be extremely cautious around its habitat! 

Try thousand-year-old life hacks from local anglers: lures and baits like Blue-Winged Grasshopper or Giant Silk Moth Larva. Check out the varied coastline, the difference in depth and the unparalleled Amazonian nature.

The unique form of the 6-feet-long of Arapaima added

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5a5948ee2f19961c11aed2784ddfb0b44dc68352.png
Arapaima are air-breathing fish that depend on access to surface air.
These fish have long, torpedo-shaped bodies covered in black-green scales with red markings. It’s dorsal and anal fins are situated closer to the tail. Arapaima are usually about 6.5 ft. in length, with some specimens growing up to 10 ft. in length and weighing as much as 440 lb!
The diet of the Arapaima mostly consists of fish and crustaceans, but these enormous creatures can sometimes devour land animals that happen to be near the shore.

Fishing in Amazonian Maze you will have a chance to catch the biggest form of Speckled Bass in our game.

New Tackles 

Rodster rod cases set
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f3319ac079a26b9b19e18d6ac0e3751fdf6d6a56.png
This Rodster rod case set is a capacious and reliable novelty from the creators of the best fishing gear at MagFin. With this rod case you’ll be sure that the tackle is safe and sound: sturdy nylon and a durable zip fastener guarantee safety while fishing and when transporting your gear. The cases come in several sizes, and what’s more important, they sport special pockets for your extra reels and lines!

 Whoa tackle box set

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/78b67a76d3849cfffd3d934cbaea25bbe5ef86c0.png
Anyone seeing this tackle box set is bound to go “Whoa”. And when you open it, you’ll definitely be surprised, because its capacity allows you to keep all the necessary fishing necessities in one place. The numerous sections and slots for your tackles, lines, reels and groundbaits are arranged in such a way as to help you quickly and easily find whatever you need this exact second. The experts at UL-CHUBER made this wonderful box capacious, sturdy and available in several sizes!
 

 Pocket Boss

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b678d96d08c321b6905d3df50767242c9d8b98d9.png
This Pocket Boss Vest by MagFin will keep you safe from the wind, and your tackle from any excess humidity! Thanks to its multiple pockets you will always have up to 50 pieces of tackle and 7 lines at the ready. And what’s more — with this vest you’ll be able to bring up to 3 groundbait components with you! This exclusive item is made of innovative nylon AquaStop® and comes in all sizes, XS to XXL.
 

 Vestern Pro

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/343939344f9a572fab31a5d709e44e5e45d7041b.png
This amazing waistcoat by MagFin is truly a great find for real pros. Rain or shine, this amazing garment will be of tremendous help to you, since it can comfortably hold 55 pieces of tackle, 5 lines and even 5 groundbait components! The material allows it to achieve optimal thermal control, keeping the warmth in when it’s cold and out when it’s hot. This is exactly what you need to have an enjoyable and fruitful fishing experience!
We also added new large keepnets and stringers that you have been waiting for.

New Baits


 Blue-Winged Grasshopper

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/016a99bd89a9fc75c7f9d4b9253bcde6fa6b6ccc.png
The Blue-Winged Grasshopper is so huge that many mistake it for a locust. Its bright wings are great at attracting surface-dwelling fish, such as Apapa. At the same time it’s weighty enough to be used for distance casts.
 

 Giant Silk Moth Larva

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/901df5cfb07a74b4ff85f26150cba1a4eadb9eb8.png
This is a larva of a giant silk moth. It’s large, fleshy and bright, which makes it a delicacy of choice for the catfish and other omnivorous fish.
 

 Banded Aracu Minnow

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/30c75ed481263af59cb689225e6300251190463e.png
The Banded Aracu is a small fish inhabiting Amazonian waterways. It’s the favorite delicacy of large predators like the huge Peacock Bass.
 

 Amazonian Sardine

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/93fef09168f87cdedf7bcb74e6151dcc169702c4.png
If you want to attract small Amazonian predators like Jacunda or Biara, the Amazonian Sardine is your best choice! This tiny elongated fish makes its carnivorous siblings bite as never before.


Get your share of the real exotic fishing experience!

Don't miss the Amazon Carnival Pack!  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/eab3cb0c239092abbbbf9f85640df3aeee831409.jpg

The best tackle for this part of the jungle for catching REALLY BIG fish: a powerful rod, a reel, lures, gear and a swift twin-engined Bass Boat Sagitta along with 30-day Pond Pass to the Amazonian Maze!

notes.title: Welcome to the River Marron, Bolivia!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/388357d5acb2c2d660457979c6f99027a0a1b19c.png

Welcome to Bolivia’s Amazon tributaries full of rare and wonderful fish! 
It’s not easy to get to the River Marron, and you can find out more useful information about the new location in our Dev's Diaries.

If you’ve found yourself in Beni Department holding a fishing rod – you surely know your exotic fishing! The further you are from civilization, the more chances you have to catch a rare fish, maybe even of an undiscovered species!

A trip to the River Marron gives you a variety of fishing options in the most interesting places:

 Travel to the lone tree in the southern part of the river to hunt for a Red Peacock Bass straight from the grassy bank or the landing pier.
 Rent a Wooden Kayak from local residents at the old boathouse, where the sharp-toothed Payara is said to make an easy catch. Wooden Kayaks will be available for rent on all Amazonian locations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/69c74db1117ed5f89aa8b57109edd5cabacec58d.png

 Visit the village in the north-east to enjoy the picturesque cableway and all the best spots to catch the golden-scaled Apapa.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b631bbf98454b16411a8395305934a128e9dfc4a.png

  Steer your boat to the western tributary to cast your rod into the quiet waters of a nearby small lake.
 Venture to a tiny island with low rocky shores to catch the Redtail Catfish hiding in shallow waters or bottom pits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e06dc633c84bd9b892bce2978b25eaa7e9198958.png


Enjoy the most impressive view where a magnificent tree grows straight out of the water. 

New unique fish, such as:

 Tambaqui 
(Colossoma Macropomum), also known as Giant Pacu or Black Pacu, is a large freshwater fish native to the Amazon and Orinoco basins in tropical South America.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/527ea2c74a9550047582869d1fda04905f035b2c.png


 Trahira
 (Hoplias Aimara), also known as Wolf Fish or Tiger Fish, is a predatory tropical fish species native to South America that lives in freshwater habitats of most river systems on the continent. 
Trahira can be found in both clear, fast flowing streams, as well as slow and still waters of canals and ponds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1b3cccf8afa4f9d6414588c6741e24adb5855427.png


 Apapa 
(Pellona Сastelnaeana) is a South American species of predatory freshwater fish found mainly in the Amazon and Orinoco basins. These highly aggressive fish swim mainly in large schools, hunting their prey closer to the surface or in shallower areas. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1e602fa9065aa4432b9e64eba083176c1145aa19.png


 Redtail Catfish 
(Phractocephalus Hemioliopterus), also known as Flat-nosed Catfish, is a large and very popular game fish found in the Amazon, Orinoco, and Essequibo river basins of South America that lives only in freshwater habitats, particularly large rivers, lakes and streams. It is the only known species of the genus Phractocephalus, that dates back to over 13.5 million years. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2c962b4cb089336be3ee7ad77d55558bc053abb8.png


 Red Peacock Bass
 (Cichla mirianae) is a tropical freshwater fish that tends to inhabit lagoons, waterways and flood plains of South American rivers. It prefers areas with slow currents and plenty of cover, such as sunken logs and submerged trees.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d80eebdf5a26f94781c1eb241081bf7163e521e9.png

New tackle

We recommend top Amazon tackle for all your tropical fishing. 
Be sure to try out the powerful bottom rod La Cazadora™ 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/63c086787b2c8ae79fc0045d06559c9a4fd6c58f.png
the Torbellino™ reel by UL-CHUBER™. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bb04e80b6be46d97339906ec0b7d97059ba46a83.png
Match Rod - SpellLauncher™
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0e8aea59ded3fb3a239b3abfde604db1165ea441.png
Spin Reel - MatchCatch™
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0a99384176d2c66ac0b0edfaf4f456d5fbd353df.png

Don’t forget about the new local baits:

 Dobsonfly, 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/32a4aa1416dc98b9c47f96dda25c3ba78b320b13.png Moriche Palm Fruit, 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a1e3431923951fc6f6f9a55ec2be6f043ca33b37.png Jauari Palm Fruit, 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a8ad4c0b3d7110c2d05d038f1e7a336fb33e3c09.png Rubber Tree Seeds 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/95e7eea25e634567d4502fb38885c69afc7eb4fd.png
Freshwater Crab
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a8168bbd5ba47d8ba3831607fefa955209096105.png



 Interesting missions and achievements.
 New max level for players – 65(unlocked at level 63).


You can find all the best stuff for local fishing in the Tropic Hunter Pack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/881a65689793212225ec37826de93004cde3e782.jpg

Traveling to Bolivia to catch wondrous water monsters – sounds like a plan! And to bring it to life we have already gathered all the best stuff in the Tropic Hunter Pack. The star of this set is the light and durable metal motor boat Lyra with a powerful engine and an innovative echo sounder Uniq, which can work without interference even at high speed! 

Tight lines to all who appreciate exotic fishing!

notes.title: Release note 3.7.2: Summer Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3a32fa678afdc12cc5c7a0e8ae16c73255ba74cd.png

Hello, anglers!
Welcome end of summer with our Summer update full of new useful improvements including:

Polarized glasses
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/35647a08bca9cf8b4eb5f102065f95262775e15e.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/723b9d320a8c08ad5a5cc0e7c22a2547120343d6.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/077bedf85bbba14417e5c4ed6873eaa4af9e168e.png
More contrast and less eye strain when fishing! New Garry Scott sunglasses are specifically designed for anglers: in addition to ultraviolet protection, they also block most of glare from light reflecting off the water surface. The line offers several models for you to highlight your unique style!

Sliders
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2810b56ede776bcb5cae8ef0472b29a804681bd1.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f298c064abc4ba77849b9618da39779cf564f884.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6c1a47543fd3759ed0fc97b8d1ac9b3737445661.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9b5ff153958ef3f7a288d489641028ec30624ea1.png
Slider floats are specially designed for sliding rigs. Sliders are able to fly further than common floats and are most often used for fishing at great depths.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f175d327184e31690f9959d2e131093e065f4a6d.jpg

Well, anglers, are you ready to explore South America? 
Then enter the Amazonian jungles and follow to the waters of Maku-Maku Lake! This magical spot in north-western Peru, where the Amazon River begins, presents a rare opportunity to challenge yourself. Local waterways are famous for the variety of rare exotic fish species inhabiting them. 

Here’s what the wild rainforest has in store for you:
 Our first Amazonian location in Peru — Maku-Maku Lake!
 16  authentic fish species, from Redeye Piranha to the giant Arapaima!
 New spinning rods for heavy lure casts and large-spooled reels.
 Swimbait lures look almost indistinguishable from a live fish, and predators can’t resist it.
 Maximum level raised to 60.
 New Rainforest Journey Pack.


Welcome Maku-Maku Lake in Peru!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1445252b4bc20da548f806950b392d4e264b725e.jpg


Maku-Maku Lake embodies everything you can dream of in a tropical paradise fishing adventure! It’s just you, the primeval jungle and scores of rare Amazon fish! Do not be deceived by the seemingly peaceful water surface: it hides the sharp-toothed Payara, the gigantic Arapaima and the vulturous Piranha.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/233c468633f3881aff53f17ec9f2959f4901682d.jpg

When exploring the lake, visit the Oval Island. At the first glance there is nothing remarkable about it apart from a landing pier and a couple of tourist lodges. But you are here for the catch, and you won’t be disappointed. The lake’s muddy bottom near the island is full of deep pits, which make perfect hiding spots for Flatwhiskered Catfish, the enormous Gilded Catfish and other members of the Amazon catfish kind. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0b333529697fa71de2bad3021ad61d5511928d7f.jpg

Otorongo Village in the south-western part of the lake is where an Amazon indigenous tribe lives. The Maku-Maku people have surely chosen their residence wisely, since the local waterways are teeming with fish! The native residents have built a landing pier for their longboats. Take your boat from there to the north of the village to find a long gentle-flowing canal, a habitat of choice for the yellow-eyed Brycon and the elusive Payara. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/70ba2db17871c88a421a4e1af0b79397ae68f615.jpg

Take a minute to relax at the Tourist Landing Pier, where you can practice your distance casts. Cosy tourist lodges, a new pier with modern boats and the unmatched tropical fishing experience – everything is ready for you to enjoy!

notes.title: Patch Note 3.5.9: 4 new Fish in Mississippi.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4db1fcf060761a4cb148da273e0fc39542b6eb3f.jpg

Hello, anglers!

Welcome, 4 new inhabitants of shoreless Blue Crab Island in Mississippi.


 The first one on our list is Shoal Bass, cousin of the Bigmouth and Smallmouth Bass. This indigenous freshwater inhabitant of the southern part of the USA, easily recognizable by its colorful body and aggressive behavior.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ea5a964a9753318659cf14a658053ce43f40f649.png
 The second one is Bigmouth Buffalo. One of the biggest species in the Catostomidae family, native North American freshwater fish, mostly known for its giant size and its long lifespan. Despite being mostly planktivorous species, it easily could be caught on sports gear. So choose the right bait and good luck!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/dc140e379ba9958d132cad8dcd58b584f07dbe46.png
 The third one is American Gizzard Shad. This small-sized, extremely fecund and gluttonous member of the herring family serves as a feeding base for many freshwater predators. But due to the enabling environment of the Blue Crab Island, it has grown to a very impressive size and catching fish more than 1 kg is not so rare. Although American Gizzard Shad feeds mainly on plankton, here in the south it also willingly bites! Arm yourself with small hooks and the same small nozzle - and you are guaranteed success!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c78dc1d273f89b4f1a2312dfaca50b14c8202956.png
 Last but not the least interesting fish species is the Black Drum. This giant inhabitant of the sea depths, well known as the largest of all the drum family. Its behavior is very common to his close relative Red Drum, and you need to look for it in approximately the same places.
   {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/32c0178df31d41a696f7ef22c37cba0a67e28bf4.png


Tight Lines!

notes.title: Patch 3.4.0 New Waterway - Mississippi Blue Crab Island!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/877e2d647d4a86d1b28cd9a01aebfcde84b29175.png

Are you ready for fabulous fishing?
Welcome to Mississippi Blue Crab Island! This picturesque place is a real paradise for anglers in the azure waters of the northern part of the Gulf of Mexico.

The trip to the Blue Crab Island is the dream of any experienced angler. Only the singing of birds and the buzzing of insects interrupt the local silence and solitude. Along the canals – thickets of sawgrass, the water here hides many large species. You can fish from a wooden pontoon near the boat station, or you can take a motor, go for a spin along the mangrove, and enjoy nature away from the coast and closer to the inhabitants of saltwater.

You've got a big party to plan here:

New level cap
Existing leveling system will be increased to 55 levels in maximum. The Mississippi Blue Crab Island will be available for all users who gained level 54. 

Locations
Despite the waterway’s impressive size, there will be  two entry locations.
The first location  - Mangrove Sunset - is situated next to a large stilt house, right in the center of the waterway and is a great spot to start exploring both fresh and saltwater areas by boat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/dc41344d72942af83acac6a46dae023350b6c419.png

The second location -  The Bass Base - is on wooden docks in the middle of a freshwater bay, amidst natural wild scenery and black mangrove trees.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/659bd07b4b81dcf3aa98090e4366a97fb2927c4e.png

Keep in mind that Mississippi is a waterway made specifically for boats and you can explore it in all possible ways.  You can also land anywhere along the coast.

New fish species
Skilled anglers have a chance to catch new fish.

Bonefish, 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/75c273e0359d32bc370a10d42510e0704fbf3624.png
Speckled Peacock Bass,
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/72042b5ad97f69e9f6b000b32b75dd1d70ba1617.png
Southern Flounder
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/659ffea173315e1b66a40b4204c84f9ac3694acd.png
and Permit.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6987ccc996892ec801352f0d464e6b2d4685455a.png

New Trophy and Unique fish

Although at first glance the pond seems calm, it hides many fish, each of which is a welcome trophy: Tarpon, Red Drum, Snook, as well as a relic resident of the local waters – the Longnose Gar.

New reinforced fishing rods and reels for catching really powerful species

Spinning Rods  Thetis™
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6b4e83deb578ef8bad698ee756771b34651531e7.png
Rivertex™ presents Thetis™ - the new and most powerful yet spinning rod that bears the name of a mighty sea goddess! An all-round superior choice for spin angling, this beauty is perfect for catching feisty beasts like trophy-sized bass, pike, salmon and muskies! Packed with Rivertex™ leading-edge technologies, like the ultra slim high modulus MaxCarbon™ alloy blank and the ResinFix™reinforcement method, this superb masterpiece of a rod features divine design to match its superior performance!

Spin Reels    ExcelSpinner™
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8c38d822f5fdb6a80bc3443dc579aacdd6046d08.png
ExcelSpinner™ is a new and even more powerful spinning reel from Rivertex™ with an elegant bronze TCP™ finish to match its might! The reel’s super large spool will make it much easier to land those trophies, while leading-edge technologies of ARTEX Slim™ reel body, HydroStop™ corrosion protected bearings and the exclusive StraighLine™ anti-backlash system ensure exceptional performance and superb durability!

Match Rods    Majesty™ 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/68baf9e15d1ea0bccf7ece25a99e02da50350d2b.png
Majesty™ is a much-awaited new and superb addition to the Rivermatch™ premium line of match rods from Rivertex™. A high-quality versatile match rod, Majesty™ features a super light and powerful blank made with the latest MaxCarbon™ high-modulus carbon fiber alloys and ResinFix™ unique curing technology to ensure optimal angling performance. Complete with FGS™ guide system and top-grade handles for improved grip, this exceptional rod is the perfect balance between power, precision and control.

Spin Reels    Empress™
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0b4aa834e9d40d7f1f1c2749b7d97f229ad8fcbb.png
Rivertex™ presents the Empress™ - a new high-performance spinning reel that is exceptionally designed for ultimate use with match rods. Packed with the company’s latest technological advancements like the EasyDrag™ and StraightLine™ anti-backlash system, the Empress™ is also equipped with MegaRoller™ smooth line roller mechanism and super durable tungsten carbide corrosion resistant TCBearings™, making it a super powerful and regal weapon for landing some big monsters!

Casting Rods    SharpCaster™ 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/62970518a4c53343b3773ec4414081fa336a5644.png
Yet another tackle masterpiece from Rivertex™, the SharpCaster™ is the company’s newest and most powerful casting rod that is great for hunting the toughest trophy-size predators. Boasting a MaxCarbon™ alloy blank in stylish electric green design and impressive muscle power due to the ResinFix™ curing method and reinforced ARTEX™ body lining technology, this superb angling weapon will keep your aim sharp and fishing battles ablaze like never before!

Cast Reels    PowerGrab™
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8f98bf45672c5543b47ac8c7722b712ea604fd05.png
A new and mega powerful casting reel from Rivertex™, the PowerGrab™ boasts delightful accuracy and unmatched precision, making it a lethal weapon for hunting predators. Equipped with all of the top Rivertex™ reel technologies, including EasyDrag™ and renowned StraighLine Duo™ anti backlash system, the PowerGrab™ is encased into a fully-machined, solid-built ARTEX™ frame and features a cool fresh design that ensure utmost durability and chic style!

New Spinning Leaders, Titanium and Fluorocarbon, for catching toothed fish.

Titanium Leader, extremely tough and durable. The perfect option for making sure you don’t lose a sharp-toothed predator halfway through the fish fight!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e7024445a0d50c300aac8b296d04da8a81b8c85f.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3aca46c6809ad71e1362747ab09bbc45a6249de9.png
Fluorocarbon Leader, sensitive and strong, virtually invisible in the water, the perfect choice for tricking those sharp-sighted predators into biting!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4400483928d6ec9011d771e564f13f43dd5dd7af.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a2a47359b586f960134d9553b20b6787b060c236.png

New lures and softbaits, including Buzzbaits, Twin Tail Spider Grubs, Slugs and Larva!
Buzzbaits
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c9ef265b8a7da7aeda4838d624d81afa286a58b5.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/365d8ca9aa0367e05ec1e06e3072f9faa9439fab.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/428220474137db9339803eff22a4bf3c666f8f95.png

SpiderGrab
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9d4e4380b84b220e1dda27c6c82657fe53a69a47.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bd07bf0687723c47903cbcbd6525c3f989228a64.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f8997bd511c9c9f9e06cc2cd5ec9541155a82e50.png

Slug
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8e0fb2aaa2f3057976f8b0d4488844a2e7430e65.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4cdb01d477cd1c873ec2111e929e43de50f5f671.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/305e6e43bed81c66f119163ca7c10fe4d1b55bb4.png

Larva
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d5eaac50144ad45c3898a6c8fa0dc6d3ff2c3fa6.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e13cb5d0b5fcf6bac6f9688d2b64fb8a09dd38af.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/59f711582c261dd587bcac55b52298ceb277d4e8.png

If you want to check out Fishing Planet’s newest and biggest angling destination surrounded by the salty waters of the Gulf of Mexico, don't forget to grab our new pack:

Tune into exploration mode right NOW with the new Bassboat Explorer Pack!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/77089336a2d739b341d91e780782cbe6110f3e98.jpg

This amazing all-you-need power pack includes:
 The speedy Garry Scott™ Scorpius™ Bass Boat for fishing adventures without limits!
 The latest and most powerful casting combo to handle the heaviest saltwater predators!
 New lures and softbaits, including Buzzbaits, Twin Tail Spider Grub, Slugs and more!
 Mississippi 30 Day Pond Pass and Advanced License for limitless fishing and exploring!The best professional anglers approve this set; it has everything you need for an unforgettable island adventure, plus an incredible bonus: Mississippi State License for 30 Day Fishing!


Grab your tackles and enjoy the island adventures!

Besides the new waterway, fish and tackle current update also includes:
 Free roaming
Now you can easily move around with gear in your hands while fighting fish. You can take out and hide the rod in any convenient place.

 Last position auto save
We have added auto save for your last position: now you can return to the very point where you were before exiting the game. This auto save would also work if your last position was on the boat, however it doesn't support saving position for the rod stands. 

 New Collections Missions:
Welcome 20 new collectionS missions. Gather your trophy collection by catching different fish species and underwater items.

 Dam Road - New location on White Moose  lake:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/52be6fe91f461d85e2946139e676264ac58834a4.png

The truly magical atmosphere of this remote and fantastically picturesque fishing location will offer you unmatched opportunities for fishing, especially if you are targeting Trout and Salmon, this fishing spot is the place to be for all those eager to enjoy the natural wonders of winter!

 Custom Competitions:
Competitive fishing becomes more profitable than before.
Added a possibility to apply for multiple sports events. We also added a new UI called "My sports events" where you can easily track all relevant events you applied for.
We are looking forward to your further feedback.


Don’t waste any time and give yourself an unforgettable fishing experience in a place where only a pleasant catch will bother you!

notes.content:

Hey, angling folks! Have yourself a great Christmas and join in on the Merry Fishmas adventures in Fishing Planet! 
Christmas starts on December 19th and will be available through January 5th.

This year, Christmas festivities are under threat! Santa’s sled was wrecked in a terrible snowstorm and crashed somewhere over Canada. Luckily, Santa is doing fine...but his reindeer went missing and all of the Christmas presents are now scattered around the world! 

Now, only YOU can help Santa to Fix The Christmas:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a42c2886c354d3eee5b855a251ce337775efe8ab.png

Santa's sleigh crashed somewhere over Canada. Gifts and Decorations are now scattered around the world.

Let's save this Christmas by filling Santa's Bag with lost gifts, decorating the Christmas tree and catching Antlered Salmons to harness them in Santa’s sleigh. 

Christmas magic will summon Crystal Fish, that can be caught only during the holiday. So stock up on snow, toss snowballs at your friends and have lots of fun and adventures on White Moose Lake!

Travel to White Moose lake and find Santa's sleigh. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e2c365a8d9ac589259d8c668bf38f48cd10cdf18.png

Catch Antlered Salmons to harness them in Santa’s sleigh instead of his runaway reindeer. Keep in mind, that Antlered Salmon bite best when someone launches fireworks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/337c3c726bd6a701c4331fb3f66142160124895a.png

Fill Santa's Bag as you explore the waterways by boat in search of lost gifts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6b06351a807d76cebd6d0cdea6718d8c93644743.png

Bring Christmas mood to the White Moose and help Santa decorate the Christmas Tree with collected ornaments.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1c5c2896fef8e09a546f73b6c61f5e40c98dc26e.png

Snowfighter

- Rodstand the Snowman -  This exclusive Christmas rod stand in the form of a jolly snowman will be your trusty companion when fishing this holiday season! Provides effective support for up to 2 rods.

Sturdy and roomy, the Santa Chummer is made of thermo-regulating material to withstand the coldest of temperatures and features additional slots for chum components!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ab515129386bff12037b17904b4a419a586afab5.png

Catch the mythical Crystal Burbot!
Complete all missions and get your chance to find out what is waiting for you in the water.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bc10c73c3d925d0465ca7ec62eb2582aed36ee94.png

Make sure to join our fairytale fishing adventure with fairytale fish like  fantastic Antlered Salmon and Furry Trout, fireworks and festive excitement!

 Logo frame
 Icon for the competition format 
 Competition name

These competitions have some special characteristics:

 Once created, such events get checked by the Administrator before publishing.

Sponsored Competitions will pose a particular interest for the more advanced sport anglers, being a perfect chance to compete against equally worthy opponents and win valuable prizes!

That’s all for now! Stay tuned to keep track of what’s fishing;)

notes.content:
Hello, anglers!
And we’re finally rolling out the much awaited feature of User Generated Competitions and much more!
User Generated Competitions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/524bbb0dc70ef03f0e7c06cbc1e7008a13544dab.png

Now, you can create and customize competitive fishing events based on your own preferences, by fine-tuning and adjusting multiple event settings, including rules, locations, time schedules, participants and much more!

We designed a whole array of new tools to make it more comfortable for you to create and host just the perfect angling competitions and set numerous parameters to your preferences:

notes.title: Developer Diaries: User Generated Competitions. Part 1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/524bbb0dc70ef03f0e7c06cbc1e7008a13544dab.png

Hello, anglers! 

It’s been a while since we last shared with you what we are working on. Today we’d like to talk about new functionality that is waiting for you in the upcoming release in the first half of November. This time we prepared for you a new type of Fishing Planet’s competitive events called Custom Competitions.  

Unlike all regular (automated) competitions, Custom Competitions are User Generated Competitions and will be created by the anglers themselves. Players will also be able to fine-tune and adjust the multiple settings of these events, including rules, locations, time schedules, and participants.

We designed a whole array of new tools to make it more comfortable for you to create and host just the perfect angling competitions and set  numerous parameters to your preferences: Templates - players can either choose from one of the preexisting competitive templates, or create a completely new competition. 
 Formats - there will be a number of formats for user competitions, depending on the type of competition:  Free For All - players aim at getting the highest personal score. 
  Team Competition - participants are divided into two teams, and each player aims at getting the highest total team score. 
  Duel - a one-on-one competition format. 

  Privacy:
  Open competition - the event is open to anyone. 
  Private competition - the event is password protected.

 Entry Fee - competition fee for those who wish to participate.
Initial Prize Pool - the amount of reward that the competition Host sets for the prize. 
 Waterway for hosting the competition. 
 Player LVLs that are admissible for participation. 
 Maximum number of participants.
 Setting for Duration and Start of the competition.
  Manual Start - competition begins after the Host starts it manually. 
  Scheduled Start - competition begins automatically at a set time. 

 Game Time/Weather tuning. 
 Qualifying Fish. 
 Count of score points - either total fish caught or fish in the Keepnet. 
 Set of score keeping Rule sets. 
 Tackle Types that are required to use in order to earn score.
 Choice of admissible equipment. 


Sponsored Competitions 

Aside from standard User Generated Competitions, in the future there will also be Sponsored Competitions. These competitions have some special characteristics and might have unique sponsor rewards.

That’s all for now! We’ll share more details on how this functionality would work in our next issue of DD this Friday. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Release Note 3.0.1: Motorboats Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e612b10dde7f74536d5d01f85342d1d7775df5b2.png

Hi, anglers!
We are excited to present you our new update! Here you can find detailed information about what are waiting for you. Explore and be ready for new adventures!

1. Motorboats 

Now you can enjoy three new types of motorboats that have unique speed, durability and vary in other params and features. 

 Metal flat bottomed motorboats. 
Slow, cheap, but extremely durable boats. You can rent the basic metal boat. However, the other ones will be equipped with sonars and better engines
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/842fb818fce24ec45e6f3ef997aff8dfcca91bc2.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b3257486dc916b5c68ad463f85d3a6501e45f63f.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/69cd417cc95d5b2c81f85b8e5361603a0d44768a.png


 Rubber inflatable motorboats.
 These motorboats come with three various sonar options that vary by color themes, speed readings and fish tracking parameters. There are also boats with different engine powers.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6c3fff106d05bbe47a23e007630436c791292d4a.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/721f4685f7b3600dcbf2ed5d1d1e616ed18a05d0.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/f42b5bd6588e7143cb8aef66e8a16c05264d918a.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/bf99c9ee974fa230c87bb4faf2dcc894198e97a3.png


 Bassboats are equipped with the best bassboat edition sonars and can develop the highest speed of all motorboats. Also, some bassboats feature, along with a trolling motor, an additional sonar installed in the front part, so that you could look for fish without having to get behind the steering wheel. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/76b9c855520197b89a037f720cd9ca469890de43.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/81bc2ef822922b393799b0c25cbccc24bb27f1a3.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/26989233b1c55c22e390295ffdbbaf5162934ba8.png


You can purchase all types of motorboats in the in-game shop and enjoy them on the following waterways: 


 Emerald Lake
 Falcon Lake
 San Joaquin Delta
 Saint Croix Lake
 White Moose Lake
 Tiber River
 Sander Baggersee Lake
 Akhtuba River


A basic edition of metal flat bottomed motorboat is also available for rent at all of these waterways. Please note that only one type of boat (metal boat or kayak) may be rented at a time!

Types of Sonars
As mentioned before all motorboats purchased in the shop may be equipped with different types of sonars that vary by color themes, speed readings and fish tracking parameters. 


 Basic - shows bottom shape and structure and works on slow speed. Color theme: monochrome.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b827984002e87de0b39e5fb67c707e5abe37bfe4.png

 Advanced - shows bottom shape and structure as well as fish. Works on slow and middle speed. Color theme: monochrome
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/3e54767d2d29ef2e3780ded25d6ea37ab1fdcebf.png


 Pro - shows fish as well as bottom shape and structure in high resolution. Works on slow, middle and high speeds. Color theme: colorful.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/81cb306699e54bab05d9ba7e16dfdc4cc94a88f3.png
 
 Also there is a  special edition sonar for the bassboat that corresponds to the Pro sonar characteristics but can work on higher speeds.
 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6ba271be055bfcb2836e50db281d63836f36a8e7.png


2. Missions

There have been added two new sets of missions: Exploration and Mastering for you to profound your angling skills and fully enjoy professional fishing. 
Explore every part of the proposed rivers, lakes and other bodies of water. Combining any fishing equipment and gear available to you, assemble a complete collection of fish species available for fishing and get the title of an explorer of each of the available places!
Use your skills to catch  Bass, Pikes, Trouts, Salmons, Catfish, Carps, and other ones that cause envy because of their size and power of opponents, and who often find themselves too tough for most anglers!

Show off your expert angling skills by masterfully comply tasks!


3. New lures added: try fishing with Jerkbaits and three type of Minnows - Deep Runner, Hunched Runner and Triple Runner

4. Changed access levels for Emerald and Rocky Lake. Now small mounting Rocky Lake unlocking on Level 5. Emerald Lake with rental motorboat unlocking on Level 8. Some tackles and lures also change access level.

5. Fish Float biting behavior improved. Various unique portraits of behavior added for different fish species 

6. UI improvements

7. Added Traditional Chinese localization

8. Сomplex bugfix

9.Don’t miss the new Motorboat Packs: Metalhead Motorboat Pack and  Daredevil Motorboat Pack  with 15% OFF!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/2751414337aae8f05f5368ac83e5464818b8f600.jpg
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1000712/Fishing_Planet_Metalhead_Motorboat_Pack/

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c4a368e246c5a45944889cfd4d7c63f3d2a6e392.jpg

notes.title: DevBlog: Motor Boats
notes.content:
Hello, angling friends! As always, Fishing Planet keeps growing and expanding its universe, along with the opportunities for fishing on different continents of the world! And as we strive to create spacious waterways with plenty of room for exploration and angling adventures, we are in turn faced by the question of better navigation. Before, you could explore new angling destinations either on foot or from a kayak. Now, we’re introducing motorboats!  

Metal flatbottomed motorboats 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/842fb818fce24ec45e6f3ef997aff8dfcca91bc2.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b3257486dc916b5c68ad463f85d3a6501e45f63f.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/69cd417cc95d5b2c81f85b8e5361603a0d44768a.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4c71e0752f2525f1bc81b5b564f9b304a7b6097d.png

Rubber inflatable motorboats
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6c3fff106d05bbe47a23e007630436c791292d4a.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/721f4685f7b3600dcbf2ed5d1d1e616ed18a05d0.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/f42b5bd6588e7143cb8aef66e8a16c05264d918a.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/bf99c9ee974fa230c87bb4faf2dcc894198e97a3.png

Bass boats
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/76b9c855520197b89a037f720cd9ca469890de43.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/81bc2ef822922b393799b0c25cbccc24bb27f1a3.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/26989233b1c55c22e390295ffdbbaf5162934ba8.png

Each type has its own unique characteristics and parameters. For example, metal motorboats are more durable, while rubber motorboats have better maneuverability and bass boats allow to move at much faster speeds.
All motorboats that you can get from the game store are equipped with sonars. However, some bass boats feature, along with a trolling motor, an additional sonar installed in the front part, so that you could look for fish without having to get behind the steering wheel. 

Motorboats are similar to kayaks in use. The only difference is that these boats have a motor that you must operate. Just as you did with kayaks, to start using a motorboat, you must first rent or buy one. Then you must get on the boat and turn on the engine by using a pull starter, or in the case of a bass boat, by pushing the start button. To turn the engine off, simply repeat this step. 

Here’s a list of waterways, where you’ll soon be able to use motorboats: 

 Emerald Lake
 Falcon Lake
 San Joaquin Delta
 Saint Croix Lake
 White Moose Lake
 Tiber River
 Sander Baggersee Lake
 Akhtuba River


This list is subject to change in the development process.

Keep track of the news to always be up to date about what’s happening in our big fishing world!;)

Akhtuba river is one of the most interesting angling destinations of the country. With its diverse structure, varying depths and currents, Akhtuba River attracts anglers, eager to explore this waterway’s countless fish species

Сhaika Creek 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/afb68b2f287076a32b095e33a392974f984ced06.jpg

-  Locals call Chaika, because of the name of an old abandoned camping site nearby, with shabby wooden houses standing since the days of USSR. Separated from the wide and moderately paced waterway by a small island, these narrow waters have a totally different dynamic with much faster current and a notably different fishing experience that comes with. 

Nevertheless, the little river armlet is swarming with a large variety of different fish: from Caspian Roach and Common Bream to Zander, Asp and Wels Catfish. 

Resting Waters 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9f9d67b4296f9a5ecccb2a733e47033b3714a77f.jpg

- Densely covered with lotuses and lily pads, it seems as if this still little lake is an aquatic pit-stop, where the hurrying current of Akhtuba River flows to fall into a tranquil slumber when tired from its incessant movement. 
The lake’s calm aquatic depth hides a plentiful array of underwater inhabitants for an angler to hunt on: Blue Bream, Volga Pikeperch, Ide, European Carp, Chub and Northern Pike just to list a few. 

Wide as the Russian Soul 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b837298326ba1a583791ccb6f97f13ef89c73991.jpg

- This beautiful fishing spot is situated on one of the vast and most spacious parts of the Akhtuba River. The broad open area surrounding this lovely riverside beach greets the traveler’s eyes with gradually sloping sandy shores overlooking a somewhat abrupt and cliffy opposite bank. 

 Enjoy this broad open space, as you indulge in catching Asp, Caspian Roach, Tench, Zeige, Silver Bream, Zander and many other fish inhabiting. 

All Hail the Pioneers 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/23c523e4514bdb7097439a34935ac1ca878dc2a7.jpg

- Further upstream, in the higher reaches of Akhtuba River, you will discover a lovely steak of a long-forgotten desolate beach that once belonged to an old summer camp for young and daring Soviet pioneers. 

Ah, what an ambient place to spend the day out fishing for Zander, Northern Pike, Asp, and Wels Catfish.

notes.title: Merry Christmas and have a good carp!
notes.content:
Hello guys!
You know that new European fish have their own unique habits, so we have a few tips for you to catch a really good silver carp or bighead carp in Germany.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/cce8e38e2d02d40b2b8acc15e3e4414f50c7eded.jpg

Firstly you need to know that silver carp and bighead carp mostly feed on zoo and phytoplankton near the water surface. 
Keep in mind that these huge carp fish almost never sink to the bottom. 
Secondly, you need to know that it’s large and strong fish! The angler, who decided to catch a few of these giants, should arm themselves with the most powerful match tackles.
And third and most importantly - the baited hook must be kept near the surface of the water! Even the largest species can be just in a few centimeters from the surface.

notes.title: Making your own chum
notes.content:
We wanted all anglers to be able to create their own effective feeder mixes, and so we added a simple and a more advanced way of making your own chum.

Simple chum making.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/f7d9310806f0f9c8bbce1884b84a28420774d157.jpg
This method will work great for anglers who aren’t too sure about their fishing priorities and have no clear preference as to the fish they want to catch. In that case, all you need to do is purchase a basic groundbait mix from the game store and add some water to it. In just a few moments, you’ll get some effective, ready-to-use chum. 
Here’s a step by step on what you need to do:
1. Buy a pack of basic groundbait mix
2. Go to the desired waterway
3. Drag the groundbait mix to the chum slot on your assembled feeder tackle (or simply double click on the pack)
4. Mix
All done!

Advanced chum making.
This method is designed for anglers who like to experiment and make the most out of all chum components to have more effective results. This means, you can mix and add different components in the desired proportions:
1. Buy all the components you want
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/fd006ef5d0b3f0f610ac3c56f3607783cc44b26f.jpg
2. Go to the waterway of your choice
3. Open the chum mixing menu
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/8564bd797b0b22e96efe9999e11338e91291c512.jpg
4. Select the desired proportions for all of the ingredients 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/7e8696e4f3761549334b117bffab1704a2c05736.jpg
You can even save your recipe if you like. To do that, you simply have to enter a name for it. In the future, you’ll be able to get that same mix, as long as you have all of the ingredients in your inventory. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e46cf7015fa7ee845f58783cf78bfe07380ea0e0.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9afc5221de30231eee87c22ea0ff6d73067852be.jpg
5. Mix
6. Get your own unique chum, put it into the chum slot, and go catch some of the biggest fish out there!

Be careful when selecting the proportions for your chum ingredients. Use such concentrated components like liquid attractants with care: just because the possible proportion for an attractant is 10%, using the maximum amount won’t necessarily make it more effective!
Unbalanced chum mixes might actually distract fish from biting. Make sure to carefully read the description of your chum mix components to get a clear idea of what you want to mix and in what proportions.
Keep in mind: the right chum, when used in the right places and conditions will not only increase your fish bites, but will attract more diverse and rare fish to the feeding spot! Experiment and explore!

Tight lines and happy feeder fishing!

notes.title: Fishing Planet 2.0: Euro Update Patch Note
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/52ba58259f2939717c11dafa76c3ece66b0d5103.png
Hey, dear friends!  We are happy to present you an awesome update full of new cool features and amazing new content!

New region added - global map is now a globe
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6fffcb2b55ce392f4f7ca2a83f0ff47a1affdb5d.jpg
We’re finally adding a completely new region of the world to Fishing Planet - Europe! Now you’ll be able to enjoy fishing on new European waterways, complete with their own unique vibe, scenic surroundings, beautiful nature and all the realistic details inherent to the region!
The global map is now represented as a 3D globe.

Five new waterways
The first iteration of the new waterways includes 5 new rivers and lakes of the European region.﻿﻿

Akhtuba River in Russia which will be unlocked in 2 weeks
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/df4d680d2506a475e85428ca430196bc05a2b607.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/76458a444a1a3fc3143826f6588d9a4316582e63.jpg


37 NEW Fish Species for you to catch! Including:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/3ef14f93d2f78eb9d728035b316fa72410bb7d96.png Bream,  https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/8da171ca6b6d70ce5fff17979403c840fba4d569.png Tench, https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/81b443bdd41b6e01d96d2bdd2aa12da749ecfad3.png Roach,  https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/7be848d0f917386b79f2e40695b1c9546823573a.png Zander, https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/66a0d1f7cc603e4c6f9a4db5a0c35be263717e39.png Crucian Carp, https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/865793799bdd9f7f4643058a7bd2271510e2ce99.png Ide,
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/7362f4d2eff24128ab4af435b1ce9068eaa8f249.png Asp, https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/aeeff1a1c5398734196e8d1ee2a9513d2d523645.png European Eel,  https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/8313dd7e4e9cc414a5a8851af20f8287c008c8a3.png Grayling,     https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6c6c139241668f518fa9fc5d260df629c4f13b61.png Marble Trout,   https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/1cd86eae7cb59b7816bc58eaf6fe89535d4ca31d.png Barbel,   https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/59e41dcf4a970be9444969a915dff03cae04d194.png Round Goby,  https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5e6ec2058b4ed97a3671529c11fd916a7f29d9e7.png Mirror Carp   and  https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9018c7ab5bdfa9ca8c92c5dfe7821705e367bb1d.png Leather Carp  and dozens more!

This update also includes few fish giants that will get on nerves of even hardcore anglers. No one can remain indifferent in the face of 60 kg Wels Catfish and Beluga. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/0af5f2976bc4914d327aa3041c4b5bb2145ce612.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6666fda82b0a0e5c4c741de2d5a48fd1b507e64c.png

New fish generation system and AI 
We have revised and reworked the fish generation system and AI to make it more realistic:
Less specific fish distribution range.
More flexible bite charts
Codependency within the fish ecosystem in the waterway.
Support of the movement of fish schools.
Consideration of  interrelation between different species of coarse fish.
More complex dependency of bites on the weather conditions.
Water temperature indicator added
Effect of chum on fish bites.
At the moment, this new system is functioning only on the newly added waterways, but will be implemented on all existing fishing destinations in the nearest future.

Bottom fishing and Feeder fishing

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b8130f816f1fc0fdf46038d0aa47397a57423720.jpg
We have added bottom fishing, including feeder fishing, to the game to enrich your angling experience.

You can catch fish by holding the rod in hand or use special rod stands that will let you make multiple casts using a number of rods simultaneously. The rod’s flexible quiver tip swill show even a slight fish bite, while using an alarm bell is a sure way no to miss it.

Fishing with feeder tackle will work almost anywhere, but this method is most popular in Europe, where there the “white”, no-predatory fish are more abundant. Crucian Carp, Bream, Tench, Common Carp, Common Barbel and many other related species are you most likely catch when feeder fishing!


Fish feeding and chum

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4d4f110ecf7ba21528bf15dd7c24da73e1708295.jpg

Another long awaited feature coming in this update is fish feeding and chums!

How Feeding works: feeding implies “providing food” for a certain areas of a waterway to attract  fish and keep them in that area. You just load some chum into the feeder and cast it to the desired spots. Once in the water, the chum begins to spread from the feeder over time, creating feed areas that attract fish. To maintain the high density feed area it’s always a good idea to make repeated casts in the same spot once in a while.

Consider that various factors like the water temperature, flow direction and speed as well as the chum composition and many others affect feed area to create realistic feel of the process.

Making your own chum
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/550f5a90f64f2239a4b9746239a0fd14fbf0982a.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/a6383bb7ca3c7812f663193ffd3016e01ccd97d3.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ab6b9bde9d1066ceb1cf0ac5a095daba60b138b4.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/66fad027dbb9faa6897a5365d8db09454358055c.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/7c819e1a31cf21eeb58a5c0b065ebc82466d1571.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/78aa698b352a1b88a9a0c002c0828b86fb141450.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/be48da3f9ab56ab770b44106402b991acc36f78d.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5cc73369897dd777f5a9d5381b76e6e9fb38fd98.png
Basic Mixing: you just add water to a groundbait of your choice and literally create a basic mix with a single click
Advanced Mixing: combine various ingredients (groundbait , different chum aromas and some particles)  in high precision proportions to create unique recipe that will fit your needs

Keep in mind: the right chum, when used in the right places and conditions will not only increase your fish bites, but will attract more diverse and rare fish to the feed area.
There is a separate Chum slot in the inventory for all the chum ingredients: groundbaits, different chum aromas and some particles. Also you can save the recipe for all mixed chums.

Multirods support
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d6ef0002717c7debe5b4e64adacf3f682da317ef.png
The coolest thing about bottom fishing is the possibility of using different rods simultaneously!
From now on, you’ll no longer need to constantly switch between rods and  baits, making the frustrating choice of what fish to catch first and what tackle to use. The multi-rod function will double your chances of a catch and let you enjoy a variety of fish hunting options!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/82e7f27ce74a80bc0d9aef8f6a986044d631ad84.jpg
We have added  new fishing equipment - the Rod Stands, that will let you catch fish using multiple rods at the same time! In this update we added 10+ different kinds of Rod Stands, that mostly differ by bite alarms and their rod capacity, being capable of holding from 1 to 4 rods each. Please note, you can take only one type of rod stands to  the waterway.

Bottom Fishing Tackle
A lot of new tackle has been added to the game for you fully enjoy new types of fishing. This includes: bottom rods, feeder rods, new reels, line leaders, open and closed feeder, bells, sinkers and new small hooks, new strong lines (mono, fluoro and braid), new super heavy casting rods and reels.

notes.title: Halloween's Missions!

 That is why we have a bunch of special missions for you.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/85213f8639a50325948643f8d24aea0d6859c7a5.png
To complete this mission you need to find an ancient magic book and choose that one potion that will help you to summon the Frankenfish.
Head over to Quankchin Lake and catch all of the wicked witch’s pets Catfish at midnight using special Halloween baits to retrieve the magic book!

“Potion of Summoning”
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/98559ca811ff38d06b80de8fd0461fccef15e77d.png
You’re in for a real scavenger hunt and plenty of fishing adventures to collect all of the necessary items for brewing the Frankenfish Summoning potion! Find the Witching Cauldron on San Joaquin and put all of the magic ingredients according to the Witching Recipe Book at the Cauldron!

In next missions you need to collect all the ingredients for the summon potion:

“Bunch of Mandrake Roots”
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/2d2deecf5ec36a5af26fcb12b2d4f7c7efc30bfb.png
Wait for nightfall and head over to Falcon Lake in the mountainous region of Oregon to find these mythical plants that will glow in the dark!

“Jar of Fish Eyes”
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/cd75f315c783e8be33cc91caad9a0b575609139c.png
The second ingredient of the Summoning Potion are Fish Eyes taken from a Bowfin that was caught after midnight using Roaches as bait! This is Frankenfish’s favorite snack and will definitely get his attentions. 

“Skeleton Tail”
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/a70d8404372fe2b5e4c9f46ef8aa11ba5944767b.png
Let’s start with the Skeleton Bluegill by getting its tail! Catch these fishy Skeletons only in special power places during night time, each corresponding a certain planet.

“Ghost Essence”
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/29fc6a337f283eeef3a7324d874f61f146541edd.png
You should put you soul into everything you do, particularly if you’re brewing a magic summoning potion! However, in this case, the Witching Book means literally adding some Ghost Pike essence! Catch enough of these fishy spooks during night time to gather a sufficient amount of their ethereal essence and attract the Frankenfish!

“Green Ogre Scale”
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/40652c09a8707195cf34e65fbc19a5d1051ba8c3.png
the summoning potion should be colored in a very sparkly shade of green. You’ll need to add plenty of green fish scales taken from the most fierce and hard-to-catch Gar in Neherrin River. 

“Albino Yeti Gills”
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b749c0b1f3d27b27a78a7cdbfa1c92089636d119.png
Catching a monster fish is quite a task. But catching an albino monster fish is even a bigger challenge! Head on over to Everglades night for your next magic ingredient and get some gills from Albino Yeti.

“Black Vampire Fin”
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ace811a3e19292987a43186c2dd2d6ed255e1875.png
Now, the recipe says that you must add the fins of blood-sucking monsters! It’s a good thing that Black Vampire Gars were recently spotted in Louisiana. Of course you can only catch them during night time at Quanchkin.


Good Luck to all brave anglers who will try to catch the Frankenfish!

notes.title: The drag systems
notes.content:
Hey, anglers! Today we’ll tell you a little about the basic purpose and functioning of the key feature of most fishing reels - the drag system.
The drag system is one of the most important mechanisms in any spinning or baitcasting reel. Basically, its purpose is to allow the line to slip instead of breaking under the excess pressure from playing a large fish. This prevents from losing your terminal tackle as well as minimizes damage to the rod and reel. 

There are two types of drag systems:

Front-drag in spinning reels

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/57100fce3987adedb4752859f308b541a6204373.png

The front-drag system is much more sensitive and will react even to the slightest pressure exerted by the fish on the line. The drag system on spinning reels is located in front of the spool. In this case, drag adjustment is accomplished by turning a screw. While the front-drag system is basically a screw that secures the spool, in baitcasting reels, the drag can be adjusted by a single push of a button. 

Rear-drag in spinning reels

The rear drag is less sensitive and is more commonly used when angling with heavier tackle to handle the bigger fish, particularly when feeder fishing, trolling or using super powerful spinning rods. It allows for quick and simple adjustment right while you’re reeling in the fish.

Patch Note 1.3.2: The Missions update.
notes.content:
Hey dear anglers,

if you’re keeping track of the posts in our Dev Diaries, you might already know that aside from introducing bottom fishing and new European waterways, our team is working hard on adding Missions to your Fishing Planet experience!

In this release we are happy to present you the 1st iteration of the Missions update - Tutorial Missions.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/eb97b7067dfc7a7ce688548491340401dce996cd.jpg

These missions are available to all players, and while they were specifically created to enrich and make the learning process more efficient for the less experienced folks, many of them will be quite useful even for the more proficient anglers. After all, Tutorial Missions are based on tasks that help you get a deeper understanding of the game as well as apply logic to choosing the best and most appropriate tackle and baits. This means, no matter how good you think you are, there still might be some cool features you overlooked!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5ae42ce947cd0076709acd8178255b7bb2b72512.jpg

Tutorial Mission are comprised of a number of tasks accompanied by hints and will be available as you progress all throughout the game.
There is a special Missions tab, where you can see the list of completed missions as well as the description and progress status of the current one. If you choose to track your current mission, all related hints and tasks will be showing up as you play the game. Or you can simply untrack your Mission to turn off the hints and mission widget.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b52f34e350f5a75159e4b85f824c5978cdf4aeda.jpg

Missions are a new addition to your overall gaming experience that can be both fun and useful, but they are optional, and whether to complete them or not is entirely up to you! However, we do hope that you’ll use this opportunity to sharpen your perspective, learn cool new things and get a better understanding of the game as you explore the Fishing Planet world with Missions and, of course, get rewards for completing them!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/0885fe694d8d5618c09523fd056e8bee2183ab1d.jpg

Like we already said, this is only the 1st iteration of Missions update. The next iteration will include more complex missions for more experienced players of average or high proficiency levels and will be aimed at exploring the waterways and mastering your fishing skills. These tasks will require a lot of effort and skill on your part, but with greater rewards to match the sweat and tears you put in! Also, the next iteration of mission will allow you to catch a new special fish that is not available in ordinary gameplay!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/cd6d922ed3f7044659b95212dcfe91b2c0aaef2e.jpg

Besides missions, Patch 1.3.2. will bring you:


new challenge: the Barbless Master
Level XP requirements changed to be in sync with new and upcoming missions.
updated local and global map UI
updated game UI
controller improvements
new sound effects
more menu music


And so, with the Missions finally out, you can substantially improve your progress, discover cool new fishing spots, tackle and features or simply test yourself to see if there was some stuff you might’ve been missing all along?

notes.title: Major Spring Update. Patch note 1.2.0.
notes.content:
Hey guys! Happy to announce that a Major Update has arrived with cool new features and improvements, some of which you’ve been waiting a very long time for! So here’s a full overview of this update’s essential points, covering the new features as well as the redesign of some existing functions and giving insight on how it all works:

Navigation: depth map and markers. 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/97918805bbd3888390c9f1786d9847103a0e099e.png
We added a navigation tablet showing a waterway map that you can use without leaving your fishing spot by simply pressing the [М] button! This map will show detailed info on the bottom shape and depth of the initial waterway (Lone Star) as well as provide a general description for the bottom terrain of other rivers and lakes. Players will be able to explore a detailed depth map for other waterways as well as get information about underwater structures and fish using fish finders that will be added to the game in the nearest future. Not only does this map make navigation easier, but it also allows you to leave Marks to highlight your latest fishing spots and add a corresponding description, as well as randomly mark places on the water surface with special Marker Buoys. But what’s even cooler is that you can share your Markers with friends!

Photo Mode
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c9096621e7662b7a01f5a154ef6775e06db47b48.jpg
Now you can capture and share your moments of triumph with others by taking beautiful photos of yourself holding that trophy catch from different angles! Just press the [P] button while you are still holding the fish and adjust the screen angle to your liking. You can also choose whether or not you want the fish stats to be displayed on your photo. You can make such screenshot of your catch within the Steam interface, by simply pressing F12. 
At this moment, Photo Mode is available only for bank fishing, but we’ll be adding this function for boat fishing a bit later as well.

Tackle Templates and Setups
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e9a57179eeca4cfd07824f3bcb592e5fa5563c3f.png
Templates for your favorite tackle combos are finally here! Simply select a free slot in the Templates Menu to save the your current tackle set-up and reassemble it whenever you need with just one click! And you can even share your set-up Templates with friends!

Limited Home Storage and Inventory Expansion
Yep, guys. Now that we’re introducing a true-to-life limited Home Storage, you’re gonna have to manage your space by getting rid of excess junk that you’re used to carrying around! But for those who still insist on more storage space, we’re adding a new option of Storage Boxes for inventory expansion that you can get as part of DLCs or from the in-game Store under the new SERVICES tab. Later on, you’ll also be able to get Storage Boxes as prizes for various in-game activities.

Lure Buoyancy Fixed
Let’s look at the two main problems regarding lure buoyancy that existed up until now, and how we fixed them, in this simple BEFORE/AFTER overview:
PROBLEM 1: The time it took lures to sink to the bottom.
BEFORE: All lures regardless of their weight would sink at identical speed. Be it a 4-gram spinner or a 56 gram bass jig, they’d go down the same.
AFTER: Now, just like in real life, a lure’s WEIGHT directly affects how fast it sinks. So now, it'll take more time for a light lure to go down than for a heavier one.
PROBLEM 2: How the lures parted from the bottom on slow retrieves.
BEFORE: Some lures would hardly take off the bottom when you made a retrieve using the first or second reeling speed. This would happen regardless of the lure’s weight. Heavy or light - they all behaved the same when you were making a retrieve, which of course wasn’t very realistic.
AFTER: Now, most of the lures will be showing some action even at the slowest retrieve speed, with the lighter lures lifting off the bottom and having more buoyancy than the heavier ones. Awesome, right?

New Physics
Namely:
1) fishing line made more rigid 
2) lure hydrodynamics improved
3) improved collision rendering 
4) line tension and rod tip action improved upon lure hitting the bottom 
5) effect of wind on the lure
6) wind direction indicators and Cardinal Directions added
Now you know where True North is and which way the wind is blowing

New sounds
An extensive reworking of background sounds and the sound of wind added.

New Challenge for exploring added at every waterway
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/1c46f6b8f2bc4c7c52530cce1c569ea56ac97133.pnghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/2a63a2f5dcc083d13a734048b382d995a9eafc5c.pnghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/0c0b4ea155cb043942fbb46b2457362ee0049916.png
Enjoy exploring the game's waterways and their picturesque premises for a certain number of days in a row to complete all three stages of each challenge.

Changes to rule settings of competitions
We fine-tuned the rules for all competitions based on the maximum total fish weight in your Keepnet: Cheesy Cat, Yellow Perch Goldrush, Fly like a Butterfly Swim like a Bass, Sturgeon in the Dark, Big Red Fish. As of now, the size of your Keepnet no longer affects the result and all fish count, including the ones you let go.

Convenient Support Form
We added info on how to reach us, as well as a convenient support contact form directly from the game! You can access this new function from the Support tab in the Settings menu. 
In the future, we’ll make it possible to attach a screenshot to your support message. 
Please keep in mind, that the Support team’s reply will be sent to the email address you used upon registration. You can verify it in the Profile tab of the Settings menu.

We have added the ability to turn Flashlights on and off using "J". However, you can connect this function to any other hotkey in the game settings.

Chinese Language added! 
Ni hao and welcome, our dear Chinese-speaking friends!

As you can see, this is one extensive update! We hope you enjoy the new features and improvements...and tight lines
