notes.title: Dev Blog #2 Road Map
notes.content:
Hey there fellow anglers! Time has come for us to share the road map and the vision we have for the future of Fishing Planet.

From day one our team had a detailed vision of how an ideal fishing game should look and how it should feel.

Since the launch of Early Access we were trying to listen to all of you and take into account what you’d like to see and what would be interesting to you. To our surprise and joy both the community’s and our own Vision practically coincided. This is great as it proves that we are all on the same page.

Surely we made some changes to prioritization of features and perks that we’ll be introducing, but the overall image of the game will stay as planned from the very beginning. This only goes to prove once again that all anglers from all over the world think alike and essentially want the same things.

But we are not only good at planning and feeling what you may want, we really do what we say and throughout last three month since we've launched Fishing Planet we have proven that. Just take a look at a shortened list of things we've done:

New big lake added
Big Halloween event 
Support for 2 new platforms added MacOsX, Linux
Intense optimization
45 features and functionality items added
12 Fish species added
3 reels added
4 rods added
New tackle type added - Crank-baits
43 lures added
About 26 known bug issues fixed
Multiple achievements added
and a lot more...


Now, we shall share what we plan on doing in future and the following list of features is divided into phases according to the time-frame of delivery.

This is only a less than a year perspective. We have a lot more in our heads =)

PHASE 1 FUNCTIONALITY CURRENTLY UNDER DEVELOPMENT

Friends functionality (first iteration)
* Ability to choose and join a common chat room with your friends on the waterway 
* Ability to invite friends to the game and get rewards for that
* Chat improvements for the “Friends” feature
* Ability to send a gift to a friend

Multiplayer
* Competitions
* Challenges
* Sportfishing Tournaments
* Tournament Series
* Tournament Ranks
* Tournament items and tackle

Quests with NPCs
* Bulletin/Announcement board on waterways with quests, news and many more interactions
* Quest items – unique items and tackle available only upon quest completion
* Catch-able water plants, trash and other stuff from the lakes’ bottom (boots, weird and scary stuff)

Free roaming across entire shorelines for the majority of current waterways
* Additional location on Michigan next week and a bigger shoreline available for walking near the Lighthouse

Further improvement of visual and physical tackle behavior to enhance realism

Introduction of new animations when landing the fish (no more teleport)

Fish AI improvements
* Fish AI in terms of  physical behavior

Additional bobber size tuning

Christmas Event
* New trout specialized waterway that’ll stay after the event
* New clothing items (with corresponding visualization. and yes, you’ll have the opportunity to dry-clean your flannel shirt;)
* Additional fun features to make the holidays a bit brighter
* New achievements
* New tackle
* New fish species


PHASE 2 FUNCTIONALITY PLANNED FOR NEAR FUTURE (3 MONTHS PERSPECTIVE)
Additional Events

Introduction of Bottom fishing

Additional fish species, including European fish species
* 80 real-life simulation fish species
* Additional rare occasional hybrids or mutant fish for quests

New various lures

New rods and reels

New waterways, including European lakes and rivers

Global map re-conceptualization (Dashboard Globe and UI improvement)

Basic fishing system improvement
* Fish escape system improvements
* Snag re-balancing and parameterization
* Ability to walk during a fish fight
* Drag functionality improvement
* UI tension/load indication improvement (additional indicators will be introduced)
* Fish fight intensification

Leveling and Travel system improvement
* Waterways will be open for travelling, no more level locks

Item Damage and Wear logics system improvement
* Additional indication for item durability

Fish AI re-conceptualization,
* diminishing hot-spots
* diminishing similar fish weights and overall predictability

Game economy overhaul (new currency, premium account improvement with addition of premium features without hurting F2P model)

Additional weather conditions and fine-tuning of current weather conditions

Enabling night fishing

Controller support (additional UI\UX improvements)

Tackle re-balance
* Enabling additional tackle parameters that are now inactive for rods and reels to make the tackle spread across levels more balanced

Waders, Boots, Clothing
* Ability to enter water when in waders and additional equipment-based functionality

License system re-balancing

Achievement re-balancing

Introduction of Steam achievements

Visualized fishing tips (i.e. 3D splashes on water, minor fish activity due to predator activity, etc.)

Video tutorials


PHASE 3 FUNCTIONALITY PLANNED FOR 3+ MONTH PERSPECTIVE

Introduction of Teams

Introduction of Clubs

Introduction of Kayaks

Introduction of Motor boats – walleye boats, bass boats (various boat models, engines, fuel tank)

Introduction of sounders and sonars

Introduction of huge lakes (some will be replicas of real huge waterways and take 20 real-time minutes to cross on a motorboat)

3D Avatars with customization

Introduction of  Co-Angling (what could be better than pushing your buddy in the water from a boat;)

Introduction of  tackle, vehicle customization

Camera improvement
* Introduction of free head movement
* Additional camera focus during a fish fight on the spot in the water with the fish

3D screenshots (taking a photo with your catch is cool, right)

Crates and keys, fun gameplay mechanics

Auction for in game items (premium accounts)

Introduction of netting – alone and while co-angling

Introduction of multiple rods support

Ability to choose how to cast

More weather conditions and improvement session

Virtual reality support

PS4 and XBOX

UWA (Windows Store)

Mac Store


PHASE 4 FUNCTIONALITY PLANNED FOR 6+ MONTHS PERSPECTIVE

Introduction of Pets (Dogs, Cats, Spouse)

Introduction of Fly fishing

Crafting (lures/groundbaits/boilies/flies)

Additional tutorials

Addition of messages and notifications in game

Local shop assortment enhancement

Introduction of cars and vehicles

Introduction of residential property

Introduction of Club HQ

Addition 3D UI for tackle change (similar to first-person shooters)

Introduction of Trophy room with taxidermist services

Introduction of 3D Garage with your boats, tackle and vehicles

Adding more lures making the variety enormous

Introduction of kits and sets

notes.content:

we hope you enjoyed Halloween week and had fun. It is time to end Halloween and get things back to real life. To do that we shall release the update 0.2.19 which shall take the Halloween goodness away and bring you some real-life thrill. The night fishing horror is now gone. Enjoy your daytime hunts.


Today we shall be stopping the sales of Trick or Treat DLC - think again and purchase it as even after Halloween the tackle from the pack is just great for float fishing. notes.title: GAR-O-WEEN IS COMING AFTER YOU!
notes.content:
Scary Halloween Fishing!
Starting today, you're in for some terrifyingly exciting fishing! Are you up for it? Then let's go!

http://i.imgur.com/OsrDcza.jpg?1

ACCEPT THE CHALLENGE IF YOU DARE
Horrible monster-mutant gars have been spotted in Missouri, North Carolina and Florida!

If you have the courage, try catching them at night (7 p.m. - 5 a.m.) using special freaky baits and glowing bobbers! 

Once you catch a certain number, and get a 3rd level unique halloween-style achievement, you'll be awarded an exclusive new item which only the monster-gar-hunters shall have in fishing planet! Be one of the few.

Hurry! The time is ticking and this event will continue only for 10 Nights.

DISCOUNTS IN PREMIUM SHOP INTRODUCED
You have asked us and there will be discounts! 30-Day and 7-Day Premium accounts at 30% OFF!

TRICK-OR-TREAT DLC PACK Available
Our EXCLUSIVE Halloween edition fishing goodies like the infernal Hell Troy Telescopic Rod and the Fire Fenix Match Rod that rose straight from the ashes, combined creepy Halloween baits, night fishing Glow Bobbers, is sure to awaken the holiday spirit and help you land the horrendous mutant Gars this Gar-O-Ween, earn the freaky new Achievements and creepy prizes! And a great Iron Maiden Stringer with Max Single Fish Weight: 55 Lb/25 kg; Total Fish Weight: 110 Lb/50 kg - Ideal for max Gars 

DISCOUNTS IN PREMIUM SHOP INTRODUCED
You have asked us and there will be discounts! 30-Day and 7-Day Premium accounts at 30% OFF!

NEW MONSTER FISH ADDED(MUTANT GARS):
Albino Ghost Gar (FLORIDA)
http://i.imgur.com/FtB5QrC.png?1
Green Ogre Gar (NORTH CAROLINA)
http://i.imgur.com/6v4iSTP.png?1
Black Vampire Gar (MISSOURI)
http://i.imgur.com/X0lAyLv.png?1

NEW REGULAR FISH SPECIES ADDED:
Flathead Catfish added to North Carolina
http://i.imgur.com/TIHtZM6.png?1

FEATURES ADDED

Exclusive rods added, available in Trick-or-Treat DLC Pack Only
New freaky baits added
Three new Halloween-style Achievements added
Exclusive tackle and equipment
Sinister evil eyes glowing in the darkness added
Sneaky evil moon added
Scary night sounds added
And small other new additions.
Bite and fish escape message logic fixed (stops showing LVL5 and up)
Drag settings can be changed by pressing 9-0
Tilde "`" HUD controls now  duplicated on F2 key

Gather all your courage and GO NIGHT FISHING!

GAROWEEN ACHIEVEMENT DETAILS
We hade added three new cumulative Achievements based on catching Halloween Monster Gars (one Achievement per each species)

SILVER BULLET ACHIEVEMENT FOR CATCHING Black Vampire Gars REWARD - SCARECROW HAT
http://i.imgur.com/GATYjGO.png?1
GRAB YOUR TORCH AND PITCHFORKS! ACHIEVEMENT FOR CATCHING Green Ogre Gars REWARD - PSYCHO KILLER VEST
http://i.imgur.com/9fXy7q5.png?1
GHOST SUMMONER ACHIEVEMENT FOR CATCHING Albino Ghost Gars REWARD - PANDORA’S BOX
http://i.imgur.com/tRpIxhU.png?1


SCARY FISHING TIPS
Keep in mind that even superb tackle alone won’t get the job done. Only your skills and knowledge will land those huge Monster Gars! Here’s a few tips: 

Gars like to stalk their prey closer to the surface, so adjusting your line leader to about 2 feet (60 cm) should do the trick.
Halloween Baits for Halloween Gars! But don’t forget about the classic Gar yummies.
Mutant Gars are feisty and muscular fish, so make sure to use the most powerful tackle available!
For big Gars use big Hooks. These fellows have huge snouts!
There are many spots where Gars feed at each location, search them if you are not afraid!
...Scary Halloween Fishing!;)

notes.title: PREDATOR HUNTER DLC PACK SERVICE UPDATE AVAILABLE
notes.content:
Hey!

Today we are introducing a new DLC - Predator Hunter Pack.

Predator Hunter Pack designed specially for predator hunters and anglers who do not feel like waiting to get Crankbaits and the newest rods and reels. The Pack contains a selection of tackle ideal for fishing Pike, Walleye and ready for Muskie and is designed to assure best possible experience for players who travel to Michigan and boost user progress to get there faster.

Purchasing the pack is a true steal deal as it is more than 50% cheaper than  the same items with ingame currency and it features a huge MagFin FishHut Keepnet G that allows to take 220 lb's of fish as well as a selection of gold items.

Pricing shall be announced later today.

The update features a tweak that makes the goods from the pack go to your home storage instead of messing up with your current set-up.

5000 CREDITS use to purchase new tackle, pay for fishing trips, repairs and any other in-game expenses.

notes.title: 0.2.12 PATCH WITH GAMEPLAY AND BALANCE UPDATE ARRIVED
notes.content:
Hey there!

Today’s update is worth getting excited over! After all, we considerably improved the balance, tuned the optimization and fixed certain gameplay issues. 

With that off our hands, we can finally return to working on the following patch - a big update with some brand new content. We hope it won’t take long and just within a few weeks you’ll have many new things to enjoy in Fishing Planet!

But that’s coming a bit later, and now we’ll tell you about the current patch:

First off, to add dynamics and challenge to the fishing process we put more power into the fish fights, letting you feel the thrill of a predator’s desperate struggle for life and freedom.

California and Florida, as well as all associated tackle and licenses are now accessible to players on earlier levels. Along with more experience for catching Common Fish, Uniques added and more intense fish fights we battle the grind and add more fun.

More Gold, really more - You get more gold for reaching higher levels and you get even more gold for earning the third stages of Achievements.

Fish population distribution changed on all waterway along with slight tuning of lure attractivity for different fish species. You'll need additional time to hunt em all down.
Please, note that Florida and California fish population distribution is subject to further tuning. You will be able to enjoy fishing there to the fullest in the following update.

Trophy Perch has been modified and now looks different from a Common Perch. Who will be the first to post a screenshot?;)

Introducing considerable optimization to the 32-bit version and an experimental Fishing Planet build for Mac. The game is running really faster now. We did a lot to optimize the game’s overall performance and reduce possible crashes. 

And, the last but not the least - a lot of options added to the settings menu. Yeah, invert mouse folk - rejoice!

Have fun fishing! Let us know what you think!:)

P.S.
All testers get a Week-long Premium for all of their help!

Here are the patch notes!

Gameplay:

Fish AI tuning (Fish AI tuning to intensify the fish fights and add the skill value to it (tackle tuned, fish AI tuned to ensure maximum fun)
Distribution of fish population on waterways tuned and changed, some species migrated to different areas on the lakes and rivers (this includes uniques being present at all lakes and rivers).
Experience reward overhaul throughout all fish diversity, game progress streamlined
Florida and California now available earlier – Everglades lvl 16 and San Joaquin lvl 18
Licenses pricing changed 
Home State relocation pricing changed
Travelling balance changed with the consideration of players current Home State
Achievements tuned and rewards changed


Features:

Fishnet capacity status now on HUD (Right under the weather conditions data)
Feedback on reel and hands when you reel in (You start reeling in slower when there's weight or fish fighting on the other end).
Trophy Yellow Perch body form added
Anti-cheat system enabled and tuned
Permanent breakdown of items introduced
Outfit damage system tuned and fixed


Physics:

Tackle physical behavior tuning and fix
Tackle physics performance optimization


Bug fixing:

Tutorial fish biting issues fixed
Chat ban fixing (players get unbanned automatically when the penalty terms ends)
Licenses fines fix (Fines are charged immediately) 
Duration of licenses bug fixed (licenses shall last a day more)
Connectivity issues significantly reduced
Inventory fixes and performance optimization
 No need to unplug your controllers anymore!


Options added to settings menu:

Environment sound volume controls added to settings (birds, rain, etc.)
VSync added to settings menu
Mouse inversion option added to settings menu
Mouse sensitivity option added to settings menu


Optimization:

Loading time dramatically reduced
Overall FPS increased at about 10+%
Fastest graphics setting is toggled automatically for low end PCs
Scenes, fish models and shaders have been heavily optimized
Fog effects tuning and optimization


Art add-ons:

Splashes diversified
Water ripples intensified


Crashes and stability:

Win 32 bit version stability significantly enhanced
Win 64 bit with 4gb RAM or less stability increased
Warning message added for users with low memory


DLC and Premium changes:

360 premium now accumulates all licenses
Crappie and Catfish DLC licenses duration increased to 7 days
Bass Fighter Pack and Trout Pioneer Pack licenses duration increased to 30 days


Other platform support

Mac platform support added and in test

As you already know, we launched a Closed Beta Test of the big gameplay update you have all been passionately waiting for.

If you have not received an invitation to the CBT you can apply for the Closed Beta test access. 

To do that, you need to send us an email at support@fishingplanet.com with "Closed Beta Test Application" in the subject line, stating your fishing or gaming experience and three things you like about the Fishing Planet game as well as three things you think need improvement. 

Please, keep in mind that CBT access is limited and we can accept ONLY 500 applications. First 500 applicants will be granted access to the CBT.

notes.title: LEVELING AND XP
notes.content:
Hey there guys!

Time to break the silence we’ve kept since Friday.

The last couple of weeks were very intense. It’s been a time of hard work and great effort. 
 
There have been a lot of questions and discussions regarding the grind, leveling and XP. Here are our thoughts on the topic:

We too feel that current leveling and XP system is a more grindy and casual that it should have been. This is not because the game devs are greedy or unwise.

There are several reasons why the current gameplay feels so grindy in terms of leveling and XP: 


    Easy fish fights
    Low XP rewards for common fish
    Lack of fish species to gain XP effectively
    XP gaps in leveling for future game mechanics (tournaments, duels, quests)
    Huge XP gaps on levels 15+ to slow down of ultra hardcore players gap from the majority


This was because we believed we could deliver additional gameplay mechanics earlier, but in fact more time was needed to implement them. Therefore, we have decided to address the grind situation with current mechanics to make your gameplay progress comfortable and fishing-oriented.

We are also aware of the leaderboard spread issue and will be addressing it soon. The competitive spirit is the cornerstone of fishing.


OUR NEXT STEPS TO REDUCE GRIND (E.T.A NEXT WEEK)
 
FISH FIGHT SYSTEM TUNING – WE ARE ALREADY TESTING A CHALLENGING FISH FIGHTS SYSTEM WITH FIXED FISH AI.
 
ADDITIONAL XP FOR COMMON
 
ADDITIONAL XP FOR TROPHY 
 
SMALLER XP GAP BETWEEN COMMON, TROPHY AND UNIQUE
 
INTRODUCING UNIQUES BACK AND ADDING MORE 
 
FLORIDA AND CALIFORNIA WILL BECOME AVAILABLE EARLIER
 
INTRODUCTION OF NEW XP LEADERBOARD SORTING UPDATED ON A WEEKLY BASIS
 
ADDING XP CAP AT LEVEL 23 THAT WOULD INCLUDE CREDITS AND GOLD

notes.title: GAMEPLAY UPDATE COMING IN 10 MINUTES, SERVER SHALL BE RESTARTED
notes.content:
Hey there, fishing folk!

Well, recently we had a lot of talk about gameplay and grind. Here are some news on that issue.

First of all, we are still  a small team and balancing takes significant time and effort. 

Sometimes the changes introduced may (and will) hurt and sometimes like today you'll hear some good news.

Remember only one thing, we do this to make the system healthy and you sufferings are not futile! 

Thank you for being with us!


As we continue the overall balance during the next week you will enjoy these changes:

GAMEPLAY PATCH NOTES

For the next week we shall introduce several gameplay improvements:

DOUBLE (200%) XP FOR COMMON FISH

QUARTER (+25%) MORE EXPERIENCE FOR TROPHY FISH

AND A NEW UNIQUE ON THE BLOCK CAN BE FOUND ON EMERALD

IF YOU HAVE A PREMIUM ACCOUNT YOU GET YOUR +50% ON TOP OF THAT!


Some sad news apply too... The Peacock exploit is reasonably tuned down.
